1.title: Gem Glow
1.description: Steven gets depressed when his favorite ice-cream sandwich brand, Cookie Cat, has been taken off the market. He soon cheers up when the Gems manage to get a hold of some of the last remaining Cookie Cats, which Steven believes may hold the key to activating his gem.

1.title: Laser Light Cannon
1.description: When a menacing red eye is about to hit Beach City, the only thing that can destroy it is a Laser Light Cannon which once belonged to Steven's mother, Rose Quartz. Thus, Steven enlists the help of his father, Greg, and they search through his storage for the cannon.

1.title: Cheeseburger Backpack
1.description: The Gems go on a mission to place a Moon Goddess statue on top of the ruined Lunar Sea Spire, and Steven tries to prove he can be useful with the help of his new novelty cheeseburger backpack.

1.title: Together Breakfast
1.description: Steven's attempt to get the Gems to share his special breakfast tradition lands him on a journey through their ancient Gem temple.

1.title: Frybo
1.description: Steven brings a mascot costume to life with a magic shard owned by Pearl to help his friend Peedee with his job, but it backfires when the mascot goes rogue.

1.title: Cat Fingers
1.description: Steven tries to master his shapeshifting abilities from Amethyst, but turns his fingers into cats, making it harder to do things.

1.title: Bubble Buddies
1.description: Steven creates a magic bubble around himself and a girl he likes, Connie, to save her from a falling rock, but has no idea how to make it disappear.

1.title: Serious Steven
1.description: While navigating out of an ancient Gem maze, Steven tries to prove himself worthy to Garnet by being serious.

1.title: Tiger Millionaire
1.description: Steven joins an underground wrestling league with Amethyst, who is tired of Pearl and Garnet bringing her down.

1.title: Steven's Lion
1.description: Steven befriends a magical lion he finds in the desert during a mission with the Gems.

1.title: Arcade Mania
1.description: Steven takes the Gems on his own kind of adventure by bringing them to the Fun Land Arcade, where Garnet soon becomes enchanted by a dancing game.

1.title: Giant Woman
1.description: Steven urges Amethyst and Pearl to fuse together into a four-armed "giant woman" named Opal (Aimee Mann). Amethyst and Pearl, however, keep on quarrelling.

1.title: So Many Birthdays
1.description: After learning that the Gems are thousands of years old, Steven decides to make up for all the birthdays they've missed.

1.title: Lars and the Cool Kids
1.description: Steven and Lars get to hang out with the cool kids (Jenny Pizza, Buck Dewey and Sour Cream) in town, but their teenage shenanigans get them into magical trouble.

1.title: Onion Trade
1.description: A toy trade between Steven and Onion escalates into epic proportions.

1.title: Steven the Sword Fighter
1.description: Pearl gets injured and retreats into her gem to heal and make a new body to project after she tries to teach Steven the art of sword-fighting using a holographic version of herself.

1.title: Lion 2: The Movie
1.description: Steven and Connie try to ride Lion to the movie theater, but Lion has other plans.

1.title: Beach Party
1.description: After a battle damages the Fish Stew Pizza sign, the Gems are banned from the restaurant, so Steven throws a cookout on the beachside to mend the relationship between the Pizza family and the Gems.

1.title: Rose's Room
1.description: Steven's desire for some alone time unlocks a new room in the Temple that answers his every wish.

1.title: Coach Steven
1.description: Against Pearl's wishes, Steven becomes determined to get stronger after watching Garnet and Amethyst fuse into the mighty Sugilite.

1.title: Joking Victim
1.description: Steven works at the Big Donut when Lars leaves Sadie with all the work.

1.title: Steven and the Stevens
1.description: Steven needs a musical partner for an upcoming show, so he uses a time travel device to recruit himself as the perfect bandmate.

1.title: Monster Buddies
1.description: Steven attempts to tame a monster's wild form when he accidentally releases it from its gem bubble.

1.title: An Indirect Kiss
1.description: Steven tells Connie about his mission with the Gems to heal Amethyst after she cracks her gemstone.

1.title: Mirror Gem
1.description: Steven befriends a magical mirror that can mysteriously communicate with only him and ends up setting free its trapped inhabitant, a Gem named Lapis Lazuli.

1.title: Ocean Gem
1.description: Lapis Lazuli disappears after reigniting a past conflict with Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl, and takes the ocean along with her, leaving Beach City in a panic on the first day of summer. Steven, Connie, Greg, Lion and the Gems go on a mission to confront Lapis and set things back to normal.

1.title: House Guest
1.description: Left homeless and with a broken leg after the events of the previous episode, Greg stays with Steven and the Gems as a temporary house guest and unintentionally interferes with Steven's healing powers.

1.title: Space Race
1.description: Steven, Pearl and Greg work together to build a spaceship so that Pearl can revisit the wonders of the cosmos, but Pearl gets a little carried away.

1.title: Secret Team
1.description: After they accidentally pop a bubble containing gem shards, Steven, Amethyst and Pearl form a secret team to retrieve the shards before Garnet finds out.

1.title: Island Adventure
1.description: Steven tries to mend Lars' and Sadie's friendship by taking them on vacation to a magical beach.

1.title: Keep Beach City Weird!
1.description: Steven is taken in by Ronaldo's conspiracy theories about paranormal occurrences in Beach City.

1.title: Fusion Cuisine
1.description: Steven asks the Gems to fuse together and pretend to be his mother at dinner with Connie's family.

1.title: Garnet's Universe
1.description: Steven interprets what Garnet did during the day after a recent mission.

1.title: Watermelon Steven
1.description: Steven grows a patch of watermelons shaped like himself, but they soon come to life and attack people.

1.title: Lion 3: Straight to Video
1.description: Lion keeps lying on Steven's face while he's sleeping. This leads to Steven discovering a pocket dimension in Lion's mane.

1.title: Warp Tour
1.description: Steven becomes uneasy after seeing an unknown object traversing through a warp stream, despite the Gems' attempts to disprove his claims.

1.title: Alone Together
1.description: While practicing how to fuse with Gems, Steven accidentally fuses with Connie, forming a half-human and half-Gem, human fusion called Stevonnie.

1.title: The Test
1.description: Steven finds out that the Lunar Sea Spire mission from the third episode was a test and demands a new one.

1.title: Future Vision
1.description: Steven learns that Garnet can see into the future and becomes paranoid about the possible dangers around him.

1.title: On the Run
1.description: Steven and Amethyst try life out on the road. During so, Amethyst reveals a dark secret about herself and the Gems to Steven.

1.title: Horror Club
1.description: Steven goes to the lighthouse to watch scary movies with Ronaldo, Lars and Sadie.

1.title: Winter Forecast
1.description: Steven has to take Connie back to her home before a blizzard hits Beach City, and Garnet shows him some outcomes before they leave.

1.title: Maximum Capacity
1.description: While cleaning out Greg's storage unit, Greg and Amethyst are reunited with their favorite sitcom Li'l Butler.

1.title: Marble Madness
1.description: When several droids from space descend towards warp pad zones, Steven and the Gems attempt to track down their purposes.

1.title: Rose's Scabbard
1.description: Pearl takes Steven to a special place that belonged to Rose Quartz after Lion finds the scabbard for Rose's sword.

1.title: The Message
1.description: Steven and the Gems need Greg's help to retrieve a message from the Wailing Stone.

1.title: Political Power
1.description: The Gems cause a power outage in Beach City, and Steven helps Mayor Dewey with damage control.

1.title: The Return
1.description: Peridot and her new partner, Jasper, arrive on Earth.

1.title: Jail Break
1.description: Trapped on Peridot's ship, Steven attempts to rescue the Gems from the Homeworld's clutches, including two Gems named Ruby and Sapphire.

2.title: Full Disclosure
2.description: Steven tries to avoid Connie so he won't have to tell her about his ordeal with the Homeworld Gems from the previous episodes.

2.title: Open Book
2.description: When Connie is upset by the ending of her favorite book series, Steven takes her to Rose Quartz's room, where they remake the ending.

2.title: Joy Ride
2.description: Buck, Jenny and Sour Cream take Steven out on a late-night joyride to lift his spirits and teach him how to have fun, until they end up discovering Peridot's escape pod.

2.title: Say Uncle
2.description: In this non-canon episode, Uncle Grandpa arrives to aid Steven in unlocking the power of his gem.

2.title: Story for Steven
2.description: Greg tells Steven the story of when he first met Rose Quartz.

2.title: Shirt Club
2.description: Steven and Buck make T-shirts.

2.title: Love Letters
2.description: When Jamie the mailman falls in love with Garnet, Steven and Connie must help turn him down gently.

2.title: Reformed
2.description: Amethyst keeps trying to find a new form to regenerate into while she, Steven and Garnet chase after a monster loose in the Temple.

2.title: Sworn to the Sword
2.description: Wanting to protect Steven, Connie takes up swordfighting lessons with Pearl.

2.title: Rising Tides, Crashing Skies
2.description: Ronaldo investigates the Crystal Gems in a web documentary for his "Keep Beach City Weird" blog.

2.title: Keeping it Together
2.description: While the Crystal Gems chase after Peridot in the Kindergarten, Steven and Garnet discover a dark secret while exploring its inner workings.

2.title: We Need to Talk
2.description: After witnessing Steven and Connie fuse again, Greg explains to them how he learned about gem fusion from his time with Rose Quartz, hoping to pull it off himself in order to grow closer to her.

2.title: Chille Tid
2.description: Garnet has Pearl and Amethyst stay with Steven, who is exhausted from searching for Malachite in the ocean with the Gems, for a slumber party. However, Steven is rattled by recurring dreams of Lapis Lazuli.

2.title: Cry for Help
2.description: When TV broadcasts are disrupted by a video signal emitted by Peridot from a Gem communication tower, Garnet chooses to fuse with Pearl into Sardonyx to destroy it, which dismays Amethyst. As the tower keeps being fixed, however, Steven and Amethyst are shocked to discover who's really behind it.

2.title: Keystone Motel
2.description: While she accompanies Greg and Steven on a road trip to another state and a visit to a motel in that state, Garnet's frustration with what Pearl did in the previous episode causes her to split into Ruby and Sapphire.

2.title: Onion Friend
2.description: When they visit Onion's house, Amethyst rekindles her friendship with his mother, Vidalia, while he shows Steven around his room.

2.title: Historical Friction
2.description: Steven is asked by Jamie to participate in a play funded by Mayor Dewey about Beach City's founding, with Pearl stepping in to provide a more historically accurate script.

2.title: Friend Ship
2.description: After the recent events, Pearl wants to redeem herself by capturing Peridot, who traps the Crystal Gems in an old, abandoned Gem spaceship.

2.title: Nightmare Hospital
2.description: Steven and Connie must sneak into a hospital to retrieve Rose Quartz's sword from Connie's mother.

2.title: Sadie's Song
2.description: Steven helps Sadie with an act for the annual Beach City Beach-a-Palooza.

2.title: Catch and Release
2.description: The Crystal Gems finally capture Peridot, but Steven suspects that she knows something and lets her live in his bathroom.

2.title: When It Rains
2.description: After Steven explains Earth's workings, including rainstorms, to Peridot, she takes Steven to the Kindergarten to tell him more about the Cluster.

2.title: Back to the Barn
2.description: The Crystal Gems and Peridot go to the family barn to build a gem drill that can take them to the Cluster's location. However, when Peridot and Pearl fight over who will lead the project, Steven suggests they build robots and compete with each other.

2.title: Too Far
2.description: Peridot gets carried away with gem gossip, and unintentionally really hurts Amethyst's feelings.

2.title: The Answer
2.description: Garnet finally tells Steven the story of how she came to be a Crystal Gem.

2.title: Steven's Birthday
2.description: Steven has a birthday party out at the barn, and decides he has some growing up to do.

2.title: It Could've Been Great
2.description: The Gems take a trip to the moon.

2.title: Message Received
2.description: Steven has doubts about believing in everyone.

2.title: Log Date 7 15 2
2.description: Steven sneaks a listen to a friend’s audio diary.

3.title: Super Watermelon Island
3.description: Steven discovers what happened to his sentient watermelons.

3.title: Gem Drill
3.description: Steven travels deep underground.

3.title: Same Old World
3.description: Steven and Lapis Lazuli go on an adventure.

3.title: Barn Mates
3.description: Steven helps two friends get along at the barn.

3.title: Hit the Diamond
3.description: When an envoy of Rubies arrive, Steven proposes a game of baseball.

3.title: Steven Floats
3.description: Steven discovers he has a new power while seeking a fresh doughnut.

3.title: Drop Beat Dad
3.description: Steven helps Sour Cream put on a show.

3.title: Mr. Greg
3.description: Steven visits Empire City with Greg and Pearl.

3.title: Too Short to Ride
3.description: Steven and Amethyst take a trip to Funland but run into trouble when their friend is too short to ride the rollercoasters.

3.title: The New Lars
3.description: Steven gets a new look into Lars' life.

3.title: Beach City Drift
3.description: Steven and Connie get into a high-speed car race with their biggest foe.

3.title: Restaurant Wars
3.description: Steven settles a rivalry between restaurant owners.

3.title: Kiki’s Pizza Delivery Service
3.description: Kiki has nightmares and Steven intervenes.

3.title: Monster Reunion
3.description: An old friend returns.

3.title: Alone at Sea
3.description: Steven and Greg take Lapis on a boat trip out to sea and find themselves in dangerous water.

3.title: Greg the Babysitter
3.description: Greg tells Steven the story of the time he and Rose babysat Sour Cream for Vidalia.

3.title: Gem Hunt
3.description: Steven, Pearl and Connie go to the Great North to hunt down a corrupted gem.

3.title: Crack the Whip
3.description: Amethyst looks after Steven and Connie while Pearl and Garnet look for Jasper's whereabouts.

3.title: Steven vs. Amethyst
3.description: Steven And Amethyst compete against each other while training with Pearl.

3.title: Bismuth
3.description: Steven discovers something the Gems thought was lost to the past inside of Lion's mane.

3.title: Beta
3.description: Steven and Amethyst visit some friends in the country but Amethyst isn't being herself.

3.title: Earthlings
3.description: Amethyst tries to exact revenge with a showdown in the Kindergarten.

3.title: Back to the Moon
3.description: Steven and the Gems revisit the Moon Base.

3.title: Bubbled
3.description: Steven gets marooned in his bubble.

4.title: Kindergarten Kid
4.description: Steven and Peridot attempt to catch an elusive speedy corrupted Gem monster in the Beta Kindergarten.

4.title: Know Your Fusion
4.description: Steven and the Gems examine fusions.

4.title: Buddy's Book
4.description: Steven visits the library with Connie and uncovers a long lost book.

4.title: Mindful Education
4.description: Steven and Connie learn to focus better.

4.title: Future Boy Zoltron
4.description: Steven tells people's fortunes at Funland.

4.title: Last One Out of Beach City
4.description: Pearl, Steven and Amethyst go to a rock show.

4.title: Onion Gang
4.description: Steven learns about Onion's secret group of friends.

4.title: Gem Harvest
4.description: In this double episode Steven’s autumn visit to the barn brings a new stranger into his life.

4.title: Three Gems and a Baby
4.description: Greg tells Steven about their first winter together

4.title: Steven's Dream
4.description: A strange dream prompts Steven to search for answers.

4.title: Adventures in Light Distortion
4.description: Steven and the Gems take off on a search and recovery mission.

4.title: Gem Heist
4.description: The Gems reach a space station that once belonged to Pink Diamond, and sneak in to rescue Greg, but in order to do so, they must play the roles they were made for, so as not to arouse suspicion.

4.title: The Zoo
4.description: Steven finds Greg in Pink Diamond's "Human Zoo", and tries to look for a way out. This proves easier said than done as the humans there are guided through a strictly scheduled and regimented life

4.title: That Will Be All
4.description: While Blue Diamond and Yellow Diamond argue over their diverging ways of coping with Pink Diamond's death, Steven, Greg and the Crystal Gems attempt to escape the space station before they are discovered.

4.title: The New Crystal Gems
4.description: Connie tells Steven the story of how she, Peridot, and Lapis attempted to take the Crystal Gems' places as the protectors of Beach City while he was in space.

4.title: Storm in the Room
4.description: Steven uses his room in the temple to create a simulated image of Rose Quartz in order to try to experience what it would be like to know his mother. He ends up confronting her with his troubled feelings about her complex legacy and her choice to create him.

4.title: Rocknaldo
4.description: Ronaldo decides to join the Crystal Gems. However, once Steven lets him join the team, Ronaldo's self-centered attitude begins to try Steven's patience.

4.title: Tiger Philanthropist
4.description: When Amethyst quits wrestling at the abandoned warehouse, Steven continues doing so himself as Tiger Philanthropist. However, Steven soon begins to doubt the point of wrestling when the audience doesn't take to his new persona.

4.title: Room for Ruby
4.description: "Navy", one of the Rubies who came to Earth to find Jasper, crashes on Earth and is welcomed in by Steven to be a Crystal Gem. However, Lapis Lazuli does not trust Navy's overly optimistic nature, knowing of her previous encounters with her.

4.title: Lion 4: Alternate Ending
4.description: Steven tries to search for secret messages Rose may have left him about his "magical destiny". Lion eventually leads him to a tape—but it's just an alternate version of the message from Rose he's already seen.

4.title: Doug Out
4.description: Steven and Connie join Connie's father on a stake out.

4.title: The Good Lars
4.description: Steven, Lars and Sadie get invited to a party with the Cool Kids.

4.title: Are You My Dad?
4.description: People disappearing from Beach City, and Steven tries to solve the mystery.

4.title: I Am My Mom
4.description: Steven struggles to fix his mistakes.

5.title: Stuck Together
5.description: Steven and Lars are stuck inside Topaz and try to look for a way to escape.

5.title: The Trial
5.description: Steven goes to court against Blue and Yellow Diamond to determine his (or rather Rose Quartz's) fate.

5.title: Off Colors
5.description: After escaping from the Diamonds, Steven and Lars encounter and befriend the "off-colors", a group of "defective" Gems who live in hiding from Gem society. Lars defends them from security robots but is critically injured in the process.

5.title: Lars' Head
5.description: After Steven brings Lars back to life with his healing powers, he discovers that Lars now shares the same powers as Lion.

5.title: Dewey Wins
5.description: Steven helps Mayor Dewey run a difficult campaign.

5.title: Gemcation
5.description: Greg and the Gems take Steven on vacation to help him relax.

5.title: Raising the Barn
5.description: Pumpkin goes missing.

5.title: Back to the Kindergarten
5.description: Steven, Amethyst, and Peridot try to spruce up the Kindergarten.

5.title: Sadie Killer
5.description: Steven and the Cool Kids start a band, but they have trouble finding their sound.

5.title: Kevin Party
5.description: Kevin is throwing a party, and Steven is invited.

5.title: Lars of the Stars
5.description: Lars rises to the occasion.

5.title: Jungle Moon
5.description: Stevonnie finds themself alone on an adventure.

5.title: Your Mother and Mine
5.description: Steven takes Garnet to meet some of his new friends.

5.title: The Big Show
5.description: Steven shoots a documentary that follows a local band as they get their first big break.

5.title: Pool Hopping
5.description: Garnet and Steven explore the most unlikely timelines in Beach City.

5.title: Letters to Lars
5.description: Steven writes about the latest news of Beach City.

5.title: Can't Go Back
5.description: Ronaldo spots something mysterious on the moon, and Steven goes to investigate.

5.title: A Single Pale Rose
5.description: Steven helps Pearl find her cell phone.

5.title: Now We're Only Falling Apart
5.description: Followed by hearing about the revelation, many problems ensue within the crystal gems' relationships.

5.title: What's Your Problem?
5.description: Amethyst convinces Steven to take a break after all he's been through.

5.title: The Question
5.description: Ruby decides to explore her own life separate from Sapphire, and has a Wild West adventure as a lonesome cowboy with the help of Steven, Amethyst, and Greg.

5.title: Made of Honor
5.description: As Ruby and Sapphire plan their wedding, Sapphire wishes that their friends from the war could be there to see it.

5.title: Reunited
5.description: The wedding of Ruby and Sapphire, with the Gems and several Beach City citizens in attendance, goes without a hitch and Garnet reforms.

5.title: Legs From Here to Homeworld
5.description: Steven tells Blue and Yellow Diamond that their final attack on the Earth corrupted the remaining Gems on the planet, instead of destroying them outright as intended.

5.title: Familiar
5.description: White Diamond believes that Steven is Pink Diamond, so Steven tries to fit Pink's part so that way he can get close enough to White to ask her about helping the corrupted gems on Earth.

5.title: Together Alone
5.description: Steven throws a party to bring his family together.

5.title: Escapism
5.description: Steven uses his psychic powers to find help.

5.title: Change Your Mind
5.description: Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

1.title: The Old Grist Mill
1.description: Lost in the mysterious woods of the Unknown, two brothers named Wirt and Gregory run into a jaded old woodsman who warns them to beware the terrifying Beast that roams the dark forest.

1.title: Hard Times at the Huskin' Bee
1.description: A bluebird named Beatrice offers to guide Wirt and Greg to Adelaide of the Pasture (the good woman of the woods) and help them get home.

1.title: Schooltown Follies
1.description: Wirt, Greg, and Beatrice get all mixed up in the musical antics of a schoolhouse of animals, a lovelorn teacher, a grouchy old benefactor, and an escaped gorilla.

1.title: Songs of the Dark Lantern
1.description: Beatrice is left out in the rain with a brainless horse while Wirt and Greg must ask for directions in a lively colonial tavern called "The Dark Lantern" where some surprising secrets are revealed about the Unknown.

1.title: Mad Love
1.description: Is millionaire Quincy Endicott's sprawling mansion haunted by a beautiful ghost, or is the tea baron going mad? Greg and Fred the Horse are on the case! Meanwhile, Wirt and Beatrice get trapped in an armoire while searching for loose change.

1.title: Lullaby in Frogland
1.description: We join Wirt and Greg on a lighthearted romp aboard the Frogland Ferry as they approach Adelaide of the Pasture. But why is Beatrice acting so glum? Things turn emotional for Greg as well when he realizes that his own frog may be better off living with his amphibian compatriots.

1.title: The Ringing of the Bell
1.description: After unexpected darkness tears the gang apart, Wirt takes charge and meets Loma, a young woman forced to do housework by an odious witch with a magic bell. Can Wirt and Greg save Lorna, and themselves, from the wicked witch?

1.title: Babes in the Wood
1.description: While Wirt and Greg lay down to rest, they're drawn into a dreamworld of cherubs, flowers, and clouds where Greg must battle the North Wind.

1.title: Into the Unknown
1.description: The origin of Wirt and Greg’s descent into the Unknown reveals itself.

1.title: The Unknown
1.description: The Beast has come. The final chapter begins.

1.title: Slumber Party Panic
1.description: Finn and Princess Bubblegum must protect the Candy Kingdom from a horde of candy zombies they accidentally created.

1.title: Trouble in Lumpy Space
1.description: Finn must travel to Lumpy Space to find a cure that will save Jake, who was accidentally bitten by Lumpy Space Princess at a tea party.

1.title: Prisoners of Love
1.description: When the Ice King kidnaps a number of princesses he sees as potential brides, Finn and Jake team with the prisoners to set everybody free.

1.title: Tree Trunks
1.description: Finn and Jake join Tree Trunks in search for the rare Crystal Gem Apple, but question whether Tree Trunks has what it takes to adventure.

1.title: The Enchiridion!
1.description: Finn and Jake go on a quest for a magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes.

1.title: The Jiggler
1.description: A jiggly creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing follows Finn and Jake home but soon feels ill effects of separation from its family.

1.title: Ricardio the Heart Guy
1.description: When a Heart Guy named Ricardio comes to Candy Kingdom, Finn gets really jealous and finds a way to get him out of the Land of Ooo.

1.title: Business Time
1.description: When Finn and Jake discover a group of businessmen frozen in an iceberg, the duo thaws them and hires them to help with their adventures.

1.title: My Two Favorite People
1.description: Jake's plan to spend time with both Lady Rainicorn and Finn backfires.

1.title: Memories of Boom Boom Mountain
1.description: Finn reflects on an upsetting experience in his past and pledges to help everyone in town, but this proves more difficult than imagined.

1.title: Wizard
1.description: Finn and Jake temporarily get magic powers from an evil wizard, but are tricked into helping stop a comet.

1.title: Evicted!
1.description: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own.

1.title: City of Thieves
1.description: Finn and Jake go off to face a thief king who has been stealing from little girls.

1.title: The Witch's Garden
1.description: Finn and Jake consider breaking up after a witch strips Jake of his powers.

1.title: What Is Life?
1.description: Finn brings a pie-throwing robot to life, but the machine begins to long for a more fulfilling existence.

1.title: Ocean of Fear
1.description: Finn struggles to overcome his fear of the ocean.

1.title: When Wedding Bells Thaw
1.description: The Ice King gets married but not before he convinces Finn and Jake to throw him a manlorette party.

1.title: Dungeon
1.description: Finn's headstrong decision to explore a dungeon in defiance of Jake's warnings leads to a dangerous escapade.

1.title: The Duke
1.description: Finn must tell the truth when he accidentally turns Princess Bubblegum bald and green and blames the Duke of Nuts.

1.title: Freak City
1.description: After being transformed into a foot, Finn joins forces with a band of misfits to make things right.

1.title: Donny
1.description: Finn and Jake try to help an obnoxious grass ogre named Donny develop better social skills, only to find out Donny's jerky behavior protects the house people from the why-wolves, which eat the house people.

1.title: Henchman
1.description: After seeing Marceline the vampire queen torment an elderly henchman, Finn steps in to be her new henchman, doing whatever he is told to do.

1.title: Rainy Day Daydream
1.description: Stuck inside the treehouse due to a knife storm, Finn and Jake use their imagination to pass the time.

1.title: What Have You Done?
1.description: Finn and Jake capture the Ice King as their prisoner, but feel guilty when unable to explain the wrongs he committed.

1.title: His Hero
1.description: The great warrior Billy inspires Finn and Jake to practice nonviolence, but the duo finds it difficult to resist old ways.

1.title: Gut Grinder
1.description: When the Fluffy People's gold has been devoured by a culprit only known as "The Gut Grinder", Finn and Jake team up to find him with his tracks.

2.title: It Came from the Nightosphere
2.description: Marceline's evil father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after Finn and Marceline accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.

2.title: The Eyes
2.description: Finn and Jake try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.

2.title: Loyalty to the King
2.description: Finn and Jake are excited to meet the Nice King who has come to Ooo. They soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know; the Ice King.

2.title: Blood Under the Skin
2.description: When Finn gets a splinter on his finger, he wants to get the best armor. In order to receive it, he must go on a quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon and survive one embarrassing situation after another.

2.title: Storytelling
2.description: Jake is sick and demands to hear a good story full of romance, fighting and suspense.

2.title: Slow Love
2.description: Finn and Jake agree to help a snail named Snorlock find a girlfriend.

2.title: Power Animal
2.description: Finn is captured by gnomes who want to use his energy to power their infernal machines, and it's up to Jake to stay focused and rescue him.

2.title: Crystals Have Power
2.description: Jake takes a pledge of nonviolence just before Finn is kidnapped by outlaws from the crystalline dimension.

2.title: The Other Tarts
2.description: Finn choses to cross the Desert of Doom to deliver the royal tarts to the annual back rubbing ceremony.

2.title: To Cut a Woman's Hair
2.description: A tree witch demands a lock of princess hair or else Jake will be sucked into her bottomless bottom.

2.title: The Chamber of Frozen Blades
2.description: Whilst the Ice King goes out to take Gunther to the hospital, Finn and Jake decide to sneak inside his lair and flex their ninja skills.

2.title: Her Parents
2.description: Jake's relationship with Lady Rainicorn is in danger when he promises to meet with her parents, as both species had a long history of war with each other. However, thanks to Jake's shape-shifting powers, they mistake the dog as one of their own, but for how long?

2.title: The Pods
2.description: Finn and Jake discover a box containing three beans. Planting them causes three pods to grow. Two of them are good and one is evil, but which is which?

2.title: The Silent King
2.description: After defeating a evil king of goblins, Finn finds himself crowned as their new king. Unfortunately, he's unable to do anything for them due to the rules of the previous king including defending the goblins from the previous king.

2.title: The Real You
2.description: Finn has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue and seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter.

2.title: Guardians of Sunshine
2.description: Finn and Jake get sucked into one of BMO's games and they have to defeat all three of his bosses.

2.title: Death in Bloom
2.description: After killing Princess Bubblegum's plant when left to take care of it, Finn and Jake make a trip to the Land of the Dead in order to get it's soul back.

2.title: Susan Strong
2.description: Finn is excited to discover what appears to be a tribe of humans living underground near the Candy Kingdom, but gets more than he expected when he tries to teach one of them about the surface world.

2.title: Mystery Train
2.description: Wanting to surprise Finn on his birthday, Jake takes Finn on a train, where they get wrapped up in a murder mystery.

2.title: Go with Me
2.description: Marceline and Jake give Finn advice so he can ask Princess Bubblegum to see a movie with him.

2.title: Belly of the Beast
2.description: In order to cure the stomach ache of a giant, Finn and Jake must break up a party happening in his belly.

2.title: The Limit
2.description: On a mission to save soldiers of the Hot Dog Princess, Finn and Jake go inside a massive maze where wishes can be granted and where Jake's stretching powers are pushed to their limits.

2.title: Video Makers
2.description: After discovering government warnings prior to movies for their film club, Finn and Jake decide to make their own, but get into a fight over the direction of their film.

2.title: Mortal Folly
2.description: When the Lich is accidentally freed from its amber prison in Princess Bubblegum's Castle, Finn and Jake must head forth to stop it from regaining its full power, all while being pestered by the Ice King to give him their blessing to marry Princess Bubblegum.

2.title: Mortal Recoil
2.description: Princess Bubblegum recovers from being dropped in the Well of Power by the Ice King; however, she is altered and her condition leads to an unlikely final showdown with one of the greatest evils in order to save all life in Ooo.

2.title: Heat Signature
2.description: Marceline plays a prank on Finn and Jake by making them believe they're vampires, but it goes too far and escalates when they're manipulated by her ghost friends.

3.title: Conquest of Cuteness
3.description: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

3.title: Morituri te Salutamus
3.description: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to bloodlust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

3.title: Memory of a Memory
3.description: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

3.title: Hitman
3.description: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to attack Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

3.title: Too Young
3.description: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

3.title: The Monster
3.description: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

3.title: Still
3.description: Finn and Jake are literally unable to move and are at the mercy of the Ice King.

3.title: Wizard Battle
3.description: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

3.title: Fionna and Cake
3.description: In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake must battle the evil Ice Queen.

3.title: What Was Missing
3.description: Finn and his friends must come together as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and get back their taken items.

3.title: Apple Thief
3.description: When Tree Trunks's apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

3.title: The Creeps
3.description: Finn and Jake receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.

3.title: From Bad to Worse
3.description: When another plague of Candy Zombies arises and Princess Bubblegum is among the undead, Finn and his friends are in a race against time to figure out how to stop it...without making things even worse!

3.title: Beautopia
3.description: Susan Strong asks Finn and Jake to help fight off the Glub Glubs in the sewers below to regain her people's home in Beautopia.

3.title: No One Can Hear You
3.description: Finn awakens after an accident to find the Candy Kingdom citizens mysteriously gone and Jake acting crazier than usual.

3.title: Jake vs. Me-Mow
3.description: Finn and Jake take on a request to protect Wildberry Princess from an unknown assassin. The assassin turns out to be a tiny cat assassin called Me-Mow, who ends up bribing Jake by poisoning him.

3.title: Thank You
3.description: The Snow Golem visits the Fire Kingdom and finds an unlikely follower.

3.title: The New Frontier
3.description: Jake dreams about his death, and Finn takes action when events from the dream start to come true.

3.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (1)
3.description: Finn and Jake find the Ice King's video diary and have a chance to unearth his secrets.

3.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (2)
3.description: The Ice King summons an army of snowmen to recover the secret tapes Finn and Jake are watching. They must work against the clock to find out the secrets enclosed within.

3.title: Marceline's Closet
3.description: Finn and Jake play Cloud Hunt in Marceline's house, but they get trapped in her closet after she comes home.

3.title: Paper Pete
3.description: Library books seek help from Finn and Jake to save them from the evil Moldari.

3.title: Another Way
3.description: Cyclops tears may heal Finn and Jake's broken toes.

3.title: Ghost Princess
3.description: Finn and Jake play detective and try to solve Ghost Princess' murder.

3.title: Dad's Dungeon
3.description: Jake's dad presents a strange challenge to the guys when he appears to them in a holographic message, telling them about a dungeon he made for them.

3.title: Incendium
3.description: Jake embarks on a solo mission to help a broken-hearted Finn.

4.title: Hot to the Touch
4.description: Finn develops a crush on Flame Princess and tries to get to know her, which proves difficult due to her destructive power.

4.title: Five Short Graybles
4.description: Follow as 5 stories intertwine together, can you find the connection?

4.title: Web Weirdos
4.description: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids.

4.title: Dream of Love
4.description: Tree Trunks is courted by an oinking suitor, but much to Jake’s dismay, this interferes with her baking habits.

4.title: Return to the Nightosphere
4.description: Marceline’s dad banishes Finn and Jake to the Nightosphere, and it stinks. Literally.

4.title: Daddy's Little Monster
4.description: Finn and Jake attempt to rescue Marceline and find out what's making her behave so strangely.

4.title: In Your Footsteps
4.description: A bear cozies up to the guys, but his true intentions may be hidden.

4.title: Hug Wolf
4.description: Finn goes through a transformation after a run-in with a hug wolf.

4.title: Princess Monster Wife
4.description: Princesses lose body parts under mysterious circumstances.

4.title: Goliad
4.description: Battling with her new realization of her own mortality, in a sleep deprived state Princess bubblegum creates her own heir to the throne. After meeting the heir, Finn and Jake decide to teach her the ways of the world.

4.title: Beyond This Earthly Realm
4.description: When Finn finds a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world and only the Ice King can help get him out.

4.title: Gotcha!
4.description: In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

4.title: Princess Cookie
4.description: Finn and Jake are called to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

4.title: Card Wars
4.description: Finn and Jake play Card Quest, an epic game.

4.title: Sons of Mars
4.description:
Magic man has most of his power taken from him by his brother, in a fit of desperation, he swaps the way Jake and Himself look.

Magic Mans brother takes Jake to Mars for punishment,

4.title: Burning Low
4.description: Princess Bubblegum may be jealous when Finn start hanging out with Flame Princess.

4.title: BMO Noire
4.description: BMO tries to find Finn's sock.

4.title: King Worm
4.description: Finn has a vivid dream that may be more than it seems.

4.title: Lady & Peebles
4.description: Princess Bubblegum and Lady Rainicorn look for Finn and Jake, who are missing after a run-in with the Ice King.

4.title: You Made Me!
4.description: When a creepy sleep-peeping Lemongrab upsets Princess Bubblegum with his creepy ways, Finn and Jake need to tend to some issues in the Outer Realm.

4.title: Who Would Win?
4.description: The guys challenge a monster to a fight but end up battling each other.

4.title: Ignition Point
4.description: Finn and Jake sneak into the Fire Kingdom to retrieve Fire Princess' scented candles and overhear a plot to assassinate the king.

4.title: The Hard Easy
4.description: Frog People seek protection from an evil lizard who's attacking their swamp.

4.title: Reign of Gunters
4.description: The Gunters cause chaos in Ooo.

4.title: I Remember You
4.description: The Ice King and Marceline bond over song and memories.

4.title: The Lich
4.description: A visit from the Lich King sheds light on Ooo's secrets.

5.title: Finn the Human
5.description: Part 2 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5.title: Jake the Dog
5.description: Part 3 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5.title: Five More Short Graybles
5.description: A series of short stories all centered around a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future.

5.title: Up a Tree
5.description: The guys' game of catch goes awry when their throwing disc is lodged in a large tree.

5.title: All the Little People
5.description: Finn receives a bag full of miniature versions of his friends.

5.title: Jake the Dad
5.description: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

5.title: Davey
5.description: Finn creates an alter ego, Davey. Davey soon begins to take over, and Jake is forced into action to get his old friend back.

5.title: Mystery Dungeon
5.description: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby, and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

5.title: All Your Fault
5.description: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

5.title: Little Dude
5.description: Finn's hat comes to life and becomes evil after it is touched by a wizard. Finn, Jake, and the wizard track the hat down, and manage to turn the hat good.

5.title: Bad Little Boy
5.description: The princesses tire of Ice King’s crazy Fionna-and-Cake fan-fiction stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how to properly write a story.

5.title: Vault of Bones
5.description: When Flame Princess begins to doubt her evilness, Finn insists she is not evil and takes her on a journey into a dungeon to help her sort out her thoughts.

5.title: The Great Bird Man
5.description: Xergiok, the former Goblin king who was deposed by Finn and Jake claims to have turned over a new leaf.

5.title: Simon & Marcy
5.description: A look at what Ice King and Marceline were like 996 years ago.

5.title: A Glitch Is a Glitch
5.description: The Ice King creates a computer virus that will delete everyone in Ooo except for him and Princess Bubblegum. Finn and Jake hack into the universal source code to destroy the virus.

5.title: Puhoy
5.description: While dwelling on a joke he told to Flame Princess, Finn finds himself trapped in a strange pillow world.

5.title: BMO Lost
5.description: BMO makes his way home after being snatched by an eagle. On its way, BMO meets Bubble and a baby, and the three decide to journey home together.

5.title: Princess Potluck
5.description: Ice King gets super jealous when he finds out that he wasn't invited to the Princess Potluck.

5.title: James Baxter the Horse
5.description: Finn and Jake stumble across a horse named James Baxter who has the ability to make sad people feel better.

5.title: Shh!
5.description: Finn and Jake make a bet to see who can not talk the longest, and the two use signs to communicate.

5.title: The Suitor
5.description: Peppermint Butler thinks that Bubblegum is working too hard in her lab, so he tries to get her a suitor.

5.title: The Party's Over, Isla de Señorita
5.description: After another one of his schemes fails, the Ice King decides to give up.

5.title: One Last Job
5.description: Jake Jr. gets involved with a group of troublemakers, and Jake is forced to reunite his old gang—which includes Tiffany who first appeared in the first season episode "My Two Favorite People"—to rescue his daughter.

5.title: Another Five More Short Graybles
5.description: A series of short stories with a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future. In this entry, Finn and Jake build a time machine. Meanwhile, Princess Bubblegum helps Cinnamon Bun overcome his fear of the dark.

5.title: Candy Streets
5.description: Lumpy Space Princess is robbed, but before she is able to explain the details to Finn and Jake, she faints.

5.title: Wizards Only, Fools
5.description: After Starchy comes down with a cold and needs a magic cure, Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum disguise themselves as wizards and sneak into Wizard City.

5.title: Jake Suit
5.description: Jake gets upset with the amount of times that Finn uses his body as a suit of armor, so he convinces Finn to trade places with him.

5.title: Be More
5.description: BMO accidentally deletes his core system files. Finn and Jake disguise themselves as MOs to infiltrate the MO factory and save BMO from a memory wipe.

5.title: Sky Witch
5.description: Marceline tracks the Sky Witch, but finds out that she may need Princess Bubblegum's help.

5.title: Frost & Fire
5.description: Flame Princess and the Ice King fight each other, prompting Finn to have an interesting dream.

5.title: Too Old
5.description: Finn, Jake and Princess Bubblegum discover a talented mutant named Lemonhope at The Pageant of Mutants. Now they must find a way to free him from the lemongrabs.

5.title: Earth & Water
5.description: Princess Bubblegum subjects Flame Princess to a series of tests to gauge Flame Princess' fiery tendencies. But when there's an emergency at the treehouse, and Princess Bubblegum leaves Cinnamon Bun to watch Flame Princess, her experiment might literally backfire in her face.

5.title: Time Sandwich
5.description: Jake crafts the most delicious sandwich ever, but when Magic Man steals it, Finn must defy the laws of space and time to win back Jake's creation.

5.title: The Vault
5.description: When Finn starts sleepwalking and dreaming about the Green Lady he filed away in his memory vault, Jake and BMO help him tap into his repressed memories to uncover a secret past. Who is the Green Lady? And how is she connected to Finn?

5.title: Love Games
5.description: Slime Princess needs a husband or else she'll lose the Slime Kingdom to her obnoxious sis. Finn steps in to save the day, but first they will need to win a series of Love Games to prove to Slime Princess's dad that they are really in love. This is definitely not what Finn signed up for!

5.title: Dungeon Train
5.description: All aboard! Finn and Jake discover a train where every car is a dungeon filled with a new foe for Finn to fight. Jake quickly gets bored and wants to leave, but Finn is having the best time and doesn't want to leave... ever!

5.title: Box Prince
5.description: Finn meets the Box Prince—a cat with a box on its back—and learns that the Box Kingdom has been taken over by an imposter. Finn must therefore help the real Box Prince reclaim the throne.

5.title: Red Starved
5.description: Finn, Jake and Marceline are trapped in an underground cavern with no red in sight. If Marceline doesn't feed, like ASAP, she will turn into a vampiric beast and suck out all of Jake's blood! So, Finn heads off to explore the cave and find something red to satiate her until they can be rescued. But time is running out!

5.title: We Fixed a Truck
5.description: Finn finds an old truck, and Jake calls Banana Man to help with the repairs. But when BMO stays up all night working on the truck, he hears on a spooky radio talk show that Princess Bubblegum is a reptilian replicant. Is it just another one of Starchy's crazy conspiracy theories, or a fact?

5.title: Play Date
5.description: Sick and tired of babysitting Ice King while the Ice Kingdom is being rebuilt, Finn and Jake call up an old friend to hang out with their annoying houseguest: Abracadaniel.

5.title: The Pit
5.description: Finn needs Lady Rainicorn's help to rescue Jake when he is kidnapped by Kee-Oth the Blood Demon.

5.title: James
5.description: Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum are attacked by nasty goo monsters in the Desert of Wonders.

5.title: Root Beer Guy
5.description: Root Beer Guy works a boring job during the day and tries to write mystery stories at night. But his life is about to change when he witnesses Finn and Jake kidnapping Princess Bubblegum! There's only one problem: no one believes Root Beer Guy...

5.title: Apple Wedding
5.description: Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig are celebrating the wedding of the year.

5.title: Blade of Grass
5.description: Finn and Jake decide it's time for Finn to get a new sword. Finn reluctantly buys a grass sword from a mysterious old man, but the sword turns out to be cursed! And unfortunately for our hero, all sales are final.

5.title: Rattleballs
5.description: Finn practices his sword fighting skills at the candy junkyard, where he meets an old gumball robot named Rattleballs. To Finn's shock, he finds out he's not the master swordsman he thinks he is. What the what?! Finn begs Rattleballs to train him, but he soon discovers his mentor's deep, dark secret... a secret that will ultimately test Finn's loyalty to Princess Bubblegum.

5.title: The Red Throne
5.description: When Flame King breaks out of his prison and takes over the Flame Kingdom again, Flame Princess turns to the one person she believes she can trust... Finn! But will Finn be able to put his feelings for Flame Princess aside long enough to help her reclaim her throne?

5.title: Betty
5.description: After a magic spell backfires, the Ice King reverts back to Simon, and seeks help from Finn, Jake, and Marceline in order to get Betty, his former fiancée, back.

5.title: Bad Timing
5.description: Love is in the air when Lumpy Space Princess reconnects with an old classmate, but will her jealousy get in the way of finding true love?

5.title: Lemonhope (1)
5.description: Tired of all of Princess Bubblegum's talk about "responsibility," Lemonhope yearns for true freedom. So he sets off on the greatest adventure of his lemony life.

5.title: Lemonhope (2)
5.description: Though Lemonhope finds refuge from the desert with monster hunter Phlannel Boxingday, he might not be able to escape the ghosts of his past.

5.title: Billy's Bucket List
5.description: Finn finds the hero Billy's bucket list and decides to complete the unfinished items as a final tribute.

6.title: Wake Up
6.description: In order to find Finn's father, Finn and Jake must commit a cosmic crime...unless the Lich beats them to it.

6.title: Escape from the Citadel
6.description: Finn and Jake follow the Lich to the Citadel, where Finn meets his long lost dad. But just how far does the apple fall from the tree?

6.title: James II
6.description: Finn and Jake discover that Clone James has been faking his own death to collect medals. Now there are 25 Jameses running amok!

6.title: The Tower
6.description: Finn doesn't like any of the new arms the princesses give him, so he builds a tower into space to find his dad and get his old arm back. But are his hopes up a little too high?

6.title: Sad Face
6.description: Once a month, while Jake's asleep, his tail stretches out of the tree house to go work as a clown in a traveling bug circus.

6.title: Breezy
6.description: With a friendly bee named "Breezy" as his wingman, Finn decides to get back into the dating game.

6.title: Food Chain
6.description: On a field trip to the Candy Kingdom Museum of Natural History, Finn and Jake learn about the food chain by becoming the food chain!

6.title: Furniture & Meat
6.description: Big money problems send Finn and Jake to Wildberry Kingdom.

6.title: The Prince Who Wanted Everything
6.description: The beautiful and sensitive Lumpy Space Prince flees his cruel parents to start a new life.

6.title: Something Big
6.description: Princess Bubblegum must rally her forces when the Candy Kingdom is rocked by a massive assault.

6.title: Little Brother
6.description: Shelby the worm discovers that he has a little brother who is bound for adventure in the nooks of Marceline's tree house.

6.title: Ocarina
6.description: Fed up with Jake's antics, his son Kim Kil Whan takes action.

6.title: Thanks for the Crabapples, Giuseppe!
6.description: Ice King and a band of misfit wizards go on a mystical road trip.

6.title: Princess Day
6.description: It's Princess Day in Ooo! You know what that means? Yep, LSP and Marceline team up to prank Breakfast Princess!

6.title: Nemesis
6.description: A shadowy figure named Peace Master targets the Candy Kingdom elite.

6.title: Joshua & Margaret Investigations
6.description: Finn and Jake's parents hunt an unearthly menace in the woods.

6.title: Ghost Fly
6.description: Jake and the tree house are haunted by a vengeful specter.

6.title: Everything's Jake
6.description: Jake finds himself trapped in a world made of himself.

6.title: Is That You?
6.description: Following an ally's memorial service, Jake begins acting strangely.

6.title: Jake the Brick
6.description: Jake wants to fulfill a bizarre lifelong ambition.

6.title: Dentist
6.description: When Finn's toothache gets too much to take, he has no choice but to go see dentist.

6.title: The Cooler
6.description: When the Fire Kingdom is struck by a natural disaster, Flame Princess turns to an unlikely ally.

6.title: The Pajama War
6.description: A Candy Kingdom slumber party devolves into panic when Finn and Princess Bubblegum vanish.

6.title: Evergreen
6.description: In a distant age, the wizard Evergreen quests to save the world.

6.title: Astral Plane
6.description: Finn's spirit is drawn into the astral plane by the power of the mysterious comet.

6.title: Gold Stars
6.description: Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig's child, Sweet P, runs into trouble on his first day of school.

6.title: The Visitor
6.description: Finn meets a friendly civilization and sees a mysterious crash site in a vision.

6.title: The Mountain
6.description: Lemongrab and Finn go on an expedition through the Mountain of Matthew.

6.title: Dark Purple
6.description: Susan Strong and her allies infiltrate the mysterious Super Porp factory.

6.title: The Diary
6.description: Jake's son TV discovers a lost diary and sets out to solve a decades-old mystery.

6.title: Walnuts & Rain
6.description: When Finn and Jake stumble into two different holes, they meet two different fates.

6.title: Friends Forever
6.description: Ice King has a plan to form a perfect circle of confidants.

6.title: Jermaine
6.description: After a chilling dream encounter, Finn & Jake are determined to reconnect with their reclusive brother.

6.title: Chips & Ice Cream
6.description: BMO'S favorite artists find a new home in the treehouse.

6.title: Graybles 1000+
6.description: Marooned on an alien world, Cuber must rely on his bag of Graybles to survive.

6.title: Hoots
6.description: A charismatic stranger in Finn's dream leads Cosmic Owl to shirk his duties.

6.title: Water Park Prank
6.description: After rescuing Princess Orangutan from Daddy-sad-heads, Finn and Jake head to a post-apocalyptic water park for a day of fun.

6.title: You Forgot Your Floaties
6.description: Finn and Jake storm Magic Man's house to rescue his new apprentice.

6.title: Be Sweet
6.description: A fed up Lumpy Space Princess leaves the woods for a glamorous career in babysitting.

6.title: Orgalorg
6.description: After a walrus race accident, Gunther starts to experience strange visions.

6.title: On the Lam
6.description: Finn's dad Martin the Human fights for freedom on a strange new planet!

6.title: Hot Diggity Doom
6.description: It's election day in the Candy Kingdom but Princess Bubblegum's attention is diverted by a mysterious presence in the sky.

6.title: The Comet
6.description: Finn, Jake and Orgalorg converge with the comet and meet their destiny.

7.title: Bonnie and Neddy
7.description: The greed of the King of Ooo leads to a crisis in the Candy Kingdom, and (ex-) Princess Bubblegum has to return briefly from exile to deal with it.

7.title: Varmints
7.description: Bubblegum turns to Marceline's help when something threatens the citizens of her homestead.

7.title: Cherry Cream Soda
7.description: The arrival of a visitor causes Cherry Cream Soda's life to fall flat.

7.title: Mama Said
7.description: The loyalty of Finn and Jake comes into question when the King of Ooo orders them to intercept a flying mushroom.

7.title: Football
7.description: BMO and Football decide upon a deal, but one of them cannot keep up their end of the bargain.

7.title: Stakes: Marceline the Vampire Queen (1)
7.description: Finn and Jake hunt a shadowy predator and Marceline asks Princess Bubblegum for a favor.

7.title: Stakes: Everything Stays (2)
7.description: As the sun rises on her last day, Marceline recalls her long extraordinary life.

7.title: Stakes: Vamps About (3)
7.description: Five foes from Marceline's past come back to cause trouble for the Land of Ooo.

7.title: Stakes: The Empress Eyes (4)
7.description: When one of her oldest adversaries targets the Ice Kingdom, Marceline rushes to Simon's rescue.

7.title: Stakes: May I Come In? (5)
7.description: Finn, Jake, Marceline, and PB set out to hunt down the Vamps. But who is hunting them?

7.title: Stakes: Take Her Back (6)
7.description: While Princess Bubblegum searches for a cure for Marceline, Finn and Jake take on one of the Vamps themselves.

7.title: Stakes: Checkmate (7)
7.description: On the eve of battle, Marceline's archenemy comes to her with a strange proposal.

7.title: Stakes: The Dark Cloud (8)
7.description: The final confrontation begins. Who will survive?

7.title: The More You Moe, The Moe You Know (1)
7.description: On BMO's birthday, Moe comes to visit and give BMO a special birthday mission. But while BMO is away, Moe begins to overstay his welcome at the tree house.

7.title: The More You Moe, The Moe You Know (2)
7.description: BMO continues its quest to adulthood. It'll discover that something went wrong in the factory where all the MOs where created.

7.title: Summer Showers
7.description: Viola tries to get a part in LSP's play, but gets made into LSP's personal assistant instead.

7.title: Angel Face
7.description: BMO convinces his friends to join him in a live action cowboy role-playing game.

7.title: President Porpoise Is Missing!
7.description: Finn and Jake attempt to track down President Porpoise before Vice President Blowfish takes over.

7.title: Blank Eyed Girl
7.description: One very spooky night, Finn and Jake come face-to-face with an urban myth.

7.title: Bad Jubies
7.description: Finn, Jake, LSP and BMO seek shelter as they contend with some deadly weather.

7.title: King's Ransom
7.description: Ice King suffers a heartbreaking loss and it's up to Finn and Jake to find the culprit.

7.title: Scamps
7.description: Finn takes a group of at-risk Candy Kingdom youth on a camping trip they’ll never forget.

7.title: Crossover
7.description: Finn and Jake crossover into Farmworld Finn's dimension.

7.title: The Hall of Egress
7.description: Trapped and alone, Finn must unravel the riddle of the weird cave with no exit.

7.title: Flute Spell
7.description: Finn has secret meetings with a powerful wizard.

8.title: Broke His Crown
8.description: When Ice King's magic crown goes haywire, Marceline and Princess Bubblegum resort to extreme measures to help him.

8.title: Don't Look
8.description: Finn unearths a treasure with a terrible price at the top of Dead Mountain.

8.title: Beyond the Grotto
8.description: Finn and Jake follow their Sea Lard into the pond in front of their home, and in doing so, are led to a strange new world.

8.title: Lady Rainicorn of the Crystal Dimension
8.description: Jake's son finds a hidden box and draws attention from a Rainicorn.

8.title: I am a Sword
8.description: When Finn begins having nightmares about his missing Finn Sword, he wonders if they are real.

8.title: Bun Bun
8.description: Finn brings a special delivery for Cinnamon Bun to the Fire Kingdom but it may come with a dangerous cost.

8.title: Normal Man
8.description: Normal Man asks for Finn and Jake's help to rescue his brother.

8.title: Elemental
8.description: Ice King digs up an item buried underneath the Ice Kingdom.

8.title: Five Short Tables
8.description: Fionna and Cake go on a cooking adventure to push Cake's art to an all-new level.

8.title: The Music Hole
8.description: Finn hears a mysterious song while judging a Battle of the Bands.

8.title: Daddy-Daughter Card Wars
8.description: Jake and his daughter Charlie fight to restore Jake's honor and win a super-secret underground Card Wars tourney.

8.title: Preboot
8.description: While searching for old human artifacts, Jake, Finn, and Susan Strong meet Tiffany, who is employed by a mysterious Doctor Gross.

8.title: Reboot
8.description: After Susan Strong's chip is activated, she goes rogue and attacks Finn.

8.title: Two Swords
8.description: Finn and Jake puzzle over the nature of a mysterious newcomer.

8.title: Do No Harm
8.description: Doctor Princess thrusts a great responsibility upon Finn. Jake goes adventuring with a new friend.

8.title: Wheels
8.description: Kim Kil Whan is worried about his daughter's future and asks Jake for some parental advice.

8.title: High Strangeness
8.description: An otherworldly encounter puts Tree Trunks on the trail of a conspiracy in the Candy Kingdom.

8.title: Horse and Ball
8.description: When disaster befalls James Baxter, it’s up to Finn and Jake to help him pick up the pieces.

8.title: Jelly Beans Have Power
8.description: Princess Bubblegum's scientific mind must wrestle with her Elemental magic potential when she's faced with a Crystal Entity.

8.title: Islands: The Invitation (1)
8.description: A mysterious craft invades Ooo and Finn believes it may hold the secrets to his past.

8.title: Islands: Whipple the Happy Dragon (2)
8.description: Finn, Jake, and Susan set sail on a ocean voyage full of wonders and danger.

8.title: Islands: Mysterious Island (3)
8.description: After waking up alone and shipwrecked, Finn investigates a bizarre island in search of his friends.

8.title: Islands: Imaginary Resources (4)
8.description: Finn and Jake travel to a land where reality has been redesigned and improved.

8.title: Islands: Hide and Seek (5)
8.description: While exploring some futuristic ruins, Susan sees glimpses of a familiar girl.

8.title: Islands: Min & Marty (6)
8.description: An unexpected revelation from Susan leads Finn closer to answers about his past.

8.title: Islands: Helpers (7)
8.description: Finn and his friends journey to a last refuge called Founders Island.

8.title: Islands: The Light Cloud (8)
8.description: Finn confronts the power behind Founders Island, but will he ever return home to Ooo?

9.title: Orb
9.description: During the journey home from their sea-faring adventure; Finn, Jake, and BMO encounter a mysterious force that enters their dreams.

9.title: Elements: Skyhooks (1)
9.description: Finn, Jake, and BMO return from their voyage to a radically changed Ooo.

9.title: Elements: Bespoken For (2)
9.description: The friends learn the story of what happened to Ooo, while Betty continues her attempt to reach Simon, but she's interrupted by someone out to steal her magic.

9.title: Elements: Winter Light (3)
9.description: Finn, Jake and Ice King break into the Ice World to confront the power-hungry evildoer responsible for the chaos in Ooo and try to rescue Betty.

9.title: Elements: Cloudy (4)
9.description: After taking a nap, Finn and Jake get separated from Betty and the Ice King. They need to get back and Jake needs to go pee.

9.title: Elements: Slime Central (5)
9.description: In order to save Ooo, Finn and Jake must gather the four elemental gems. They go to the Slime Kingdom and have to gather Slime Princess's gem.

9.title: Elements: Happy Warrior (6)
9.description: After gathering the Slime jewel, Finn and LSP go to the Fire Kingdom, to gather the Flame Jewel. Everything has turned even hotter than before.

9.title: Elements: Hero Heart (7)
9.description: After going to the Fire Kingdom, Finn becomes taken over by fire. LSP has to save him before he destroys the candy kingdom.

9.title: Elements: Skyhooks II (8)
9.description: After saving Finn the human during a battle between the candy kingdom and the fire kingdom it is discovered that LSP is made of anti-elemental magic and restores Ooo to it's former state.

9.title: Abstract
9.description: Jake struggles through the personal changes happening to him as a mysterious encounter in a dream with his brother Jermaine begins to haunt him.

9.title: Ketchup
9.description: BMO and Marceline play catch up on recent events.

9.title: Fionna and Cake and Fionna
9.description: While performing a reading of 'Fiona and Cake', Ice King is confronted by a familiar figure.

9.title: Whispers
9.description: While safeguarding a frightened Sweet P, Finn is led into a confrontation with an old foe.

9.title: Three Buckets
9.description: Finn and Fern's carefree visit to some old ruins turns disastrous.

10.title: The Wild Hunt
10.description: A fierce creature is terrorizing the Candy Kingdom but before Finn can slay the beast, he must first overcome a guilty conscience.

10.title: Always BMO Closing
10.description: BMO and Ice King hit the road as door to door salesmen and stumble upon an irresistible opportunity.

10.title: Son of Rap Bear
10.description: When Flame Princess is coaxed into a high stakes battle against the indomitable Son of Rap Bear, Finn must help her search for a new strategy.

10.title: Bonnibel Bubblegum
10.description: A long lost artifact causes Princess Bubblegum to harken back to the creation of the Candy Kingdom.

10.title: Seventeen
10.description: A mysterious knight crashes Finn's birthday bash and presents him with a dangerous gift.

10.title: Ring of Fire
10.description: When an old flame comes calling on urgent business, Tree Trunks reconsiders both her wild past and her tranquil present.

10.title: Marcy & Hunson
10.description: After helping with the creation of a new sword, Hunson Abadeer comes back to try and regain his daughter's love.

10.title: The First Investigation
10.description: Kim Kil Whan tasks Jake and Finn to investigate reports of a haunting in one of Kim Kil Whan's properties "Joshua and Margaret Investigations" since something in there traumatized his top employee Renny Hamlond and does not pay any rent for inhabiting the place.

10.title: Blenanas
10.description: Finn's latest literary work meets with only derision, so he sets out to prove all the naysayers wrong.

10.title: Jake the Starchild
10.description: In order to fulfill his grand destiny, Jake is spirited away by a strangely familiar shape-shifting alien.

10.title: Temple of Mars
10.description: Searching for answers on Mars, Finn and Jermaine discover that they must first survive a cunning Martian mental trap.

10.title: Gumbaldia
10.description: Finn and Jake, as ambassadors of the Candy Kingdom, travel to a powerful new city-state in a last ditch effort to stave off war.

10.title: Come Along With Me
10.description: In the distant future, many years after the outcome of the Gum War, two friends named Beth and Shermy recover a rusty old mechanical arm that once belonged to Finn after it is dropped by a Prize Ball Guardian.

1.title: Self-Proclaimed Psychic: Reigen Arataka ~And Mob~
1.description: Psychics fight with supernatural phenomena that cannot be explained by science. Arataka Reigen that runs the Spirits and Such Consultation office is one of those psychics... well, a fake one. His only hope is a super dull middle-schooler named Shigeo Kageyama, a.k.a. Mob. 27% towards Mob's explosion.

1.title: Doubts About Youth ~The Telepathy Club Appears~
1.description: The Telepathy Club is told that they are going to be shut down by the student council due to lack of members. It was then that one of the members, Inukawa, thought of possibly getting Mob to join. However, Mob gets a call from Reigen about taking care of an incident at Highso Girls' Academy...

1.title: An Invite to a Meeting ~Simply Put, I Just Want to Be Popular~
1.description: It's great that Mob joined the Body Improvement Club, but he suddenly faints as he's running along the riverside. His wish is to get stronger and to be able to get closer to his beloved Tsubomi-chan. One day, as Mob is feeling troubled, a woman with a strange mask approaches him... Progress toward Mob's explosion: 20%.

1.title: Idiots Only Event ~Kin~
1.description: After the incident with the religious organization (LOL), the evil spirit, Dimple, keeps following Mob around. Also, because of the incident, Mezato Ichi from the school paper starts following around Mob, as well. Then one day, another student joins the Body Improvement Club. Progress Towards Mob's Explosion: 45%

1.title: OCHIMUSHA ~Psychic Powers and Me~
1.description: Mob is challenged to a one-on-one fight with Black Vinegar Middle School's shadow leader, Teruki Hanazawa, otherwise known as Teru. Mob doesn't use his powers but Teru goes all out on him, destroying everything around him. Teru continues to unleash his incredible power when Mob suddenly remembers a tragedy that happened between him and Ritsu...

1.title: Discord ~To Become One~
1.description: Peaceful days return after Mob's fight with Teru. As usual, Reigen continues to trick people as a fake psychic, and the president of the Telepathy Club, Tome Kurata, drags Mob around to find other espers. Then one day, a mysterious man talks to Mob's younger brother, Ritsu...

1.title: Exaltation ~I've Obtained Loss~
1.description: Salt Middle School undergoes deep cleaning lead by the student council president, and one thug after another gets targeted. Meanwhile, the story about Mob defeating the shadow leader at Black Vinegar Middle School starts to get embellished and takes on a life of it's own, and Mob gets to be known as "White T Poison." All of the gang leaders from the other schools start to gather at Salt Middle School to confront White T Poison. Also, Ritsu awakens to his dormant psychic powers, and Dimple manages to convince Ritsu to pair with him to become stronger than his brother. Ritsu finally gets to experience those powers for himself.

1.title: The Older Brother Bows ~Destructive Intent~
1.description: After defeating all of the gang leaders from the surrounding schools, Ritsu feels omnipotent. And then, he's confronted by none other than his older brother, Mob. Mob knew that Ritsu had wanted psychic powers for a while, so he congratulates him. However Ritsu doesn't greet his brother with kindness. Meanwhile, a mysterious man watches the brothers from a distance. He easily manages to grab Ritsu, and tries to drag him off. Mob activates his powers in order to save his brother.

1.title: Claw ~7th Division~
1.description: Ritsu and the others get abducted by a mysterious man named Koyama, and get taken to the secret organization Claw's 7th Division. Claw is an organization who is trying to lead the world to a better future by taking it over. One of Claw's assassins, Terada goes after Mob and Teru, but they overpower him and get him to tell them secrets about the organization. In order to save Ritsu, Mob heads to the 7th Division but encounters another member of Claw.

1.title: The Heinous Aura ~Mastermind~
1.description: Mob and Teru infiltrate the Claw's 7th Division to save Ritsu. Meanwhile, Ritsu tries to escape with the other esper kids and they run into the upper echelon and leader of the 7th Division. Teru and Dimple run into trouble after a strenuous battle, and the boss from Claw finally shows himself...

1.title: Master ~Leader~
1.description: Mob, Ritsu, and Teru are trapped in a room where they can't use their powers. And then, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of them: Mob's master and self-proclaimed psychic, Reigen. Somehow, Reigen is mistakenly thought as the boss of Claw, and easily manages to get inside and successfully saves Mob and the others. However, there is no way that Ishiguro would let them get away with this. As they try to escape the 7th Division, the upper echelon stands in their way.

1.title: Mob and Reigen ~A Giant Tsuchinoko Appears~
1.description: Mob is finally pushed to his limit when he has to face Sakurai, Muraki, Matsuo and Ishiguro of the upper echelon. But then, he comes to a rather surprising decision...

2.title: Ripped Apart ~Someone Is Watching~
2.description: Reigen received a phone call at his office, the Spirits and Such Consultation Office. The client asked him to find out what the black shadow that kept destroying his fields actually was. Meanwhile, back at Salt Middle School, Kamuro announces that he's going to resign from the position of student council president. Elections to decide a new student council president are going to be held and Mezato convinces Mob to run as a candidate, but...

2.title: Urban Legends ~Encountering Rumors~
2.description: Because of the lack of clients visiting or calling his office, Reigen decides to take his business on the road. They go to Cuticle City where there seems to be various urban legend sightings. They immediately get a request to deal with something called the Dragger. With the help of a local psychic they happened to meet named Shinra Banshomaru they go to take care of the Dragger as well as the other urban legends that plague the city.

2.title: One Danger After Another ~Degeneration~
2.description: Reigen sets up an official homepage for his Spirits and Such Consultation Office and he immediately starts to get jobs left and right, including a middle-aged man asking Reigen to curse someone and a woman who's being haunted by a ghost. As he was listening to their problems, Mob realizes something. Why do people treat humans and spirits so differently? Meanwhile, Reigen gets another request from a group of college students that want to take a photo at a haunted location, but...

2.title: Inside ~Evil Spirit~
2.description: Reigen and Mob receive a new job. This time, their client is a wealthy man named Asagiri Masashi. He's not just rich, but super rich, so Reigen and Mob head to his mansion only to find other self-proclaimed psychics there as well. One of the psychics there happens to include the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union, Jodo Kirin. The job is apparently to exorcise the evil spirit that is apparently possessing his daughter, Minori.

2.title: Discord ~Choices~
2.description: Mob gets trapped inside a parallel world created by Mogami Keiji. Minori ends up transferring to his class, and Mob becomes the target of bullying. He can't ask anyone for help, and his negative emotions start to build inside. The truth behind the tragedy that Mogami went through when he was alive comes to light. Meanwhile, Reigen and the others were waiting for Mob to regain consciousness back at the Asagiri mansion. Dimple attempts to save Mob by infiltrating Minori's body.

2.title: Poor, Lonely, Whitey
2.description: After hanging out with the Body Improvement Club and Telepathy Club more, Mob starts to feel joy like he'd never felt before. One day while he's having fun with them, he gets a call from Reigen, spoiling his fun. Mob asks Reigen to stop summoning him so suddenly, and Reigen just handles the situation in his usual overbearing manner. And because of something very minor, a gap forms between them. Reigen is forced to go on jobs without Mob, forcing him to reexamine himself.

2.title: Cornered ~True Identity~
2.description: After splitting up with Mob, Reigen starts doing a lot of the jobs on his own. He then gets an offer to appear on a TV program. Reigen is ecstatic and accepts the offer, but this was all a trap set by Jodo Kirin, the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union. Jodo corners him during the live filming of the show and the fact that Reigen is a fraud comes to light. Reigen gets bashed from all sides and ends up having to hold a press conference...

2.title: Even Then ~Continue Forward~
2.description: The day for the annual marathon and Salt Middle School was drawing nearer. Mob proclaims that if he places in the top 10 he'll tell Tsubomi how he feels about her. Everyone around him cheers Mob on and he starts training hard every day until the day of the event. Meanwhile, Tsubomi and her friend Miki go to Reigen's Spirits and Such Consultation Office with a request. Ritsu happened to be at the office, helping out in Mob's absence, but he hears Tsubomi say something rather surprising.

2.title: Show Me What You've Got ~Band Together~
2.description: With his house up in flames, Mob and Dimple find something that resembles his family burnt within the fire. They immediately go to find who's behind this and run into members of the mysterious group, the Claw. Unable to control his rage, Mob disposes of them immediately, but then Koyama and Sakurai from the 7th Division appear before him. They end up meeting up with Teru and Reigen, who were also attacked by members of the Claw, at a secret lair. What could the Claw be plotting?

2.title: Collision ~Power Type~
2.description: The boss of the Claw, Suzuki Toichiro barricades himself into Seasoning City Culture Tower after declaring war on the world. After instantly getting rid of the police barriers, they make their next move. Meanwhile, back at the hideout, Reigen and the others were making their move, as well. The former members of the 7th Division and the Awakening Lab head to the tower under Reigen's instruction. Sho and Ritsu also make their move to stop Suzuki's plans.

2.title: Guidance ~Psychic Sensor~
2.description: Sho finally arrived at Seasoning Cultural Tower and was greeted by Shimazaki, one of the Ultimate 5. Ritsu faces off with Shimazaki and urges Sho to go ahead. However, Shimazaki is able to teleport and he gets ahead of him. Meanwhile, Mob has woken up and is heading to the tower and is also approached by one of the Ultimate 5, Minegishi. Mob has a difficult time dealing with Minegishi, who controls plants, but then someone rather unexpected comes to his aid.
