2.title: The Battle for Social Rehabilitation ~Friendship~
2.description: Three years ago, Serizawa was troubled with about his psychic powers. One day, he was visited by the boss, Suzuki Toichiro. Serizawa ends up trusting him since he's the first person to understand what he's going through. But Mob then brings up the fact that Serizawa is being used and tells him, "I'll be your friend." Hearing Mob say that, Serizawa... Meanwhile, after defeating Sho, the boss starts gathering up the energy he was sharing with his followers and turns into an energy monster.

2.title: Boss Fight ~The Final Light~
2.description: The Cultural Tower floats above Seasoning City. The final battle between Mob and Suzuki was about to begin. Mob is almost overwhelmed by the fact that he's able to completely release his powers, but then, he sees his younger brother, Ritsu. Mob regains his composure and he faces off with Suzuki, but Suzuki's power is too great. Mob finally gives up on trying to talk things out and puts everything he has into this battle. Who will be the victor?

3.title: Future ~Career Paths~
3.description: A giant broccoli known as the Divine Tree grows in the middle of the city and looks down upon Seasoning City. It's time to fill out surveys about career paths at Salt Middle School and the students are filled with various feelings. While they all talk about their hopes and dreams, Mob can't seem to think of anything himself.

3.title: Yokai Hunter Amakusa Haruaki Appears! ~The Threat of a Hundred Demons!!~
3.description: Mob is very busy preparing for the cultural fair that's coming up in two weeks. Meanwhile, Serizawa is trying to start over, and is thinking about going to night school.

3.title: Getting Carried Away ~100%~
3.description: Mob is in a great mood because he got to talk to Tsubomi for the first time in a while. As he's walking through town, he feels the stares of other girls...

3.title: Divine Tree 1 ~The Founder Appears~
3.description: After Psycho Helmet's appearance, tree roots start emerging all around the city. Sensing danger, Mob goes with Reigen and Ritsu to destroy the Divine Tree, but eventually, they are overwhelmed by the members of the Psycho Helmet Religion.

3.title: Divine Tree 2 ~Peace~
3.description: Mob heads into the Divine Tree, only to have to face off with Teru. Mob finds himself speechless, having to confront even Teru who has been completely brainwashed by Psycho Helmet.

3.title: Divine Tree 3 ~Dimple Is~
3.description: Mob's attitude seems to change once he hears what Dimple says. Mob ends up apologizing to Dimple because he had gotten carried away from the thought of being popular and didn't hear what Dimple had to tell him before.

3.title: Transmission 1 ~Winter Break~
3.description: Kurata Tome has always dreamed about communicating with the universe through telepathy, and now, her high school graduation was drawing nearer. When they are about to start winter break, she tells the Telepathy Club that she is going to disband them.

3.title: Transmission 2 ~Encountering the Unknown~
3.description: The group somehow finally makes it to the summit of Mt. Mudboat. Takenaka had been up all night reading all the texts about UFOs and the Telepathy Club comes together to send a telepathic message into space, but there is no UFO in sight.

3.title: Mob 1 ~Moving~
3.description: After winter break is over, Mob is hit with shocking news. Tsubomi is actually going to transfer within the next month.

3.title: Mob 2 ~Rival~
3.description: Mob tries to save a child that is about to be run over by a car and is run over himself. People start to gather but Mob stays silent.

3.title: Mob 3 ~Trauma~
3.description: Mob continues to walk to the park where Tsubomi is waiting as he destroys everything around him, but the former upper echelon members from the Claw, Koyama, Sakuragi, and their boss, Suzuki stand in his way.

3.title: Confession ~The Future~
3.description: Mob continues down his path of destruction. Amongst all of the destruction and chaos, Reigen finally reaches Mob with the help of Serizawa, and he desperately tries to talk to him.

1.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
1.description: After escaping from Central Prison, the Freezing Alchemist, Isaac McDougal, sets his plan in motion to kill Führer King Bradley. However, under the command of Lt. Col. Roy Mustang, the military and State Alchemists attempt to stop him.

1.title: The First Day
1.description: On the way to Lior, Ed and Al reminisce about the events that lead to them being trapped in their current bodies by breaking the taboo of human transmutation. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang looks back on the first time he met the Elric brothers.

1.title: City of Heresy
1.description: Ed and Al arrive at the city of Lior, hoping to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone so they can return their bodies back to normal. There, they meet a priest named Cornello, who is able to perform "miracles." As Ed and Al investigate, they find out the truth about Cornello.

1.title: An Alchemist's Anguish
1.description: Ed and Al become interested in biological transmutation after witnessing a chimera in Lior, so Colonel Mustang introduces them to an expert in the field, Shou Tucker, the Life-binding Alchemist. Meanwhile, a serial killer whose targets are only State Alchemists is on the loose in Central.

1.title: Rain of Sorrows
1.description: After learning about what happened to Shou Tucker and his daughter Nina, the Elric brothers begin to question what alchemy really is. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang and the other State Alchemists track down the serial killer Scar.

1.title: Road of Hope
1.description: After their encounter with Scar, Ed's automail and Al's armor need to be repaired, so Major Armstrong escorts them to their hometown of Risembool. On their way there, they spot Dr. Marcoh, a scientist who helped create the Philosopher's Stone, and try to convince him to give them the location of the Stone's research data.

1.title: Hidden Truths
1.description: When Ed and Al arrive at the Central Library they discover that it has been burnt to the ground and instead are taken to see Sheska, a former employee who may have the information they seek. Meanwhile, in East City an unexplained explosion causes Colonel Mustang to restart his search for Scar.

1.title: The Fifth Laboratory
1.description: Ed and Al sneak inside the Fifth Laboratory to search for more answers about the origins of the Philosopher's Stone. However, it is not long before they are each attacked by former death row murderers who now guard the complex.

1.title: Created Feelings
1.description: Ed is now in a hospital recovering from his wounds and Al is unable to let go of what Number 66 told him back at the Fifth Laboratory. Meanwhile, Winry agrees to make a trip to Central in order to repair Ed's automail... again!

1.title: Separate Destinations
1.description: When the conspiracy surrounding the Philosopher's Stone closes in on the highest ranks of the military, one of Mustang's most trusted and cherished allies is murdered.

1.title: Miracle at Rush Valley
1.description: The Elrics, realizing alchemy has yet to unlock the mysteries of creating life, feel powerless when a new friend goes into labor. Winry, however, jumps into action with a young thief named Paninya.

1.title: One is All, All is One
1.description: While visiting Izumi, their childhood teacher, the Elrics recall the early difficulties of grasping equivalent exchange. They also discover she shares their intimate knowledge of alchemy's greatest taboo.

1.title: Beasts of Dublith
1.description: Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.

2.title: Those Who Lurk Underground
2.description: In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.

2.title: Envoy from the East
2.description: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

2.title: Footsteps of a Comrade-in-Arms
2.description: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

2.title: Cold Flame
2.description: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

2.title: The Arrogant Palm of a Small Human
2.description: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

2.title: Death of the Undying
2.description: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other alive again.

2.title: Father Before the Grave
2.description: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

2.title: Advance of the Fool
2.description: Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

2.title: Backs in the Distance
2.description: Scar's mission to destroy those who slaughtered his people is fueled by justifiable rage. Upon learning the role Scar played in her parents' deaths, Winry claims those murderous feelings as her own.

2.title: Girl on the Battlefield
2.description: Cooperation between Mustang's cabal and Ling Yao's band leads to the capture of a Homunculus. Unfortunately, their actions also capture the eye of the Homunculus hiding atop the military's ranks.

2.title: Inside the Belly
2.description: Gluttony's twisted powers overwhelm the Elrics - and the creature's appetite is satisfied by battle's end. Meanwhile, Mustang acts on his suspicions of Bradley and finds himself in the belly of the beast.

2.title: Doorway of Darkness
2.description: The Homunculi are winning. Ed and Ling face a horrific enemy within the hellish expanse of Gluttony's gut. In Central, Mustang can only watch as his loyal band of soldiers is divided by Bradley.

2.title: Reunion
2.description: Truths are exposed when Al finds the one called Father, and Mustang hears the tale of Bradley's creation - but the most amazing revelation is reserved for Ed after he once again breaks alchemy's greatest taboo.

3.title: Interlude Party
3.description: Visions of the past play out by a warming fire as Hohenheim reflects on the unavoidable follies of man: the pain that comes with a loving family; the hidden truths of alchemy; and the roots and results of war.

3.title: Father
3.description: The Elrics come face to face with Father - and his face is familiar indeed. Powerless and amazed, Ed and Al can only watch as Father creates a new Homunculus with alchemy that should be impossible.

3.title: Struggle of the Fool
3.description: The Elrics are at Bradley's mercy; if the brothers make one wrong move, those dearest to them will pay. As Mustang quietly gathers allies at his side, Ed discovers there may be no need to find a Philosopher's Stone.

3.title: The Ishvalan War of Extermination
3.description: As Edward hears Hawkeye's tale of a time when idealistic young soldiers were tasked with genocide, the horrors of the Ishvalan battlefield are revealed.

3.title: The 520 Cens Promise
3.description: Even as his subordinates are scattered, Mustang finds he still has allies - unfortunately, so do his enemies. The Homunculi unleash one of the Ishvalan War's most notorious killers to deal with Scar and Marcoh.

3.title: The Führer's Son
3.description: A secret encounter allows Mustang to spark new ambition in an old friend - an ally with loyal troops at his command. Meanwhile, Ed and Al share a chance meeting with their biggest fan - young Selim Bradley.

3.title: The Northern Wall of Briggs
3.description: The frigid northern borderlands become a battlefield when Kimblee finally closes in on Scar. Deeper into the frozen wasteland, Ed and Al's fight is against the bitter elements as they struggle to reach Fort Briggs.

3.title: Ice Queen
3.description: The soldiers at Fort Briggs remain ever vigilant against the threat of spies from Drachma. The massive compound may seem impenetrable - but a violent intruder offers destructive proof to the contrary.

3.title: The Shape of This Country
3.description: Ed uncovers a conspiracy of staggering scope: a plot that has already claimed countless victims. Clues suggest that Fort Briggs will soon know bloodshed - and an entire nation will suffer.

3.title: Family Portrait
3.description: As Raven tries to corrupt Armstrong, Ed and Al can only wait in their cell. Long ago, their father faced his own captivity, confined to an eternity of regret in an undying body. To escape the pain, he said goodbye.

3.title: The First Homunculus
3.description: Hawkeye is shocked when the first Homunculus reveals itself. Far away, Edward is surprised by an offer from Kimblee: Fullmetal can have all he has searched for - in exchange for becoming a mass murderer.

3.title: Conflict at Baschool
3.description: When Scar is cornered by a pair of gruesome chimeras, the Elrics enter the fray as his unlikely allies. Later, Winry's attempt to confront Scar over his role in her parent's death ends in disaster.

3.title: Daydream
3.description: The ruse of Winry's abduction by Scar is revealed, but a plan of rescue must still be hatched. A brutal storm is coming - one which only Alphonse Elric can brave.

4.title: Homunculus (The Dwarf in the Flask)
4.description: Long ago, the blood of a simple slave was used in an experiment which created a strange, shapeless being. In exchange for the gift of existence, the being gave the slave a name - and cursed him with immortality.

4.title: The Abyss
4.description: Bound by more than blood, the Elrics have long shared joy and pain. Now, with Al wandering the frigid void - and Ed losing blood by Kimblee's hand - the mystical connection of their souls could prove fatal.

4.title: Signs of a Counteroffensive
4.description: May and Marcoh's efforts to decode the research of Scar's brother yield progress, but it might be too late to prevent catastrophe. Violence is spreading across the land, and it will soon reach the northern border.

4.title: Bite of the Ant
4.description: In the snowy north, the soldiers of Fort Briggs engage an invading army, and Marcoh leads an attack against monstrous Envy. In Central, an ominous and shocking secret is revealed to Olivier Armstrong.

4.title: Revving at Full Throttle
4.description: Hohenheim and Alphonse enjoy a chance to get reacquainted. Their bond is restored with ease, inspiring the father to share his secrets with his sons - but one of them is far away and on the run.

4.title: The Promised Day
4.description: Quiet warnings spread near and far: the Promised Day is at hand. While most will face the coming chaos with their own kind, Edward forms a new cabal comprised of human, chimera - and Homunculus.

4.title: Looming Shadows
4.description: Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

4.title: Emissary of Darkness
4.description: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

4.title: The Oath in the Tunnel
4.description: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

4.title: Filial Affection
4.description: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

4.title: Upheaval in Central
4.description: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

4.title: The Immortal Legion
4.description: Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield -Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

4.title: Combined Strength
4.description: With a Philosopher's Stone in his possession, Alphonse fearlessly engages Pride and Kimblee. Elsewhere, the Armstrongs find themselves trapped between Sloth's onslaught and the guns of Central's troops.

5.title: Flame of Vengeance
5.description: After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.

5.title: Beyond the Inferno
5.description: As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from burning out of control.

5.title: The Adults' Way of Life
5.description: A rebel victory is imminent and hope takes hold among Mustang and Armstrong's troops. Central's forces teeter on the brink of collapse - until their fallen leader returns to take control.

5.title: The Return of the Führer
5.description: Central's forces fight with renewed vigor following Bradley's return, and the Fuhrer himself enters the battle. His first opponent is an armored tank. His second foe is even tougher.

5.title: Eternal Leave
5.description: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Fuhrer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

5.title: Sacrifices
5.description: Mustang must make a difficult choice: will he break alchemy's greatest taboo? Or will he watch the person dearest to him die? Meanwhile, it grows ever more difficult to discern where Ling ends and Greed begins.

5.title: Lost Light
5.description: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

5.title: Eye of Heaven, Gateway of Earth
5.description: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

5.title: He Who Would Swallow God
5.description: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

5.title: A Fierce Counterattack
5.description: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

5.title: The Other Side of the Gateway
5.description: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

5.title: Journey's End
5.description: Ed and Al start a new adventure in searching for new and innovative ways of alchemy.

1.title: Ryomen Sukuna
1.description: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

1.title: For Myself
1.description: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

1.title: Girl of Steel
1.description: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

1.title: Curse Womb Must Die
1.description: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

1.title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
1.description: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

1.title: After Rain
1.description: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

1.title: Assault
1.description: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

1.title: Boredom
1.description: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

1.title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
1.description: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

1.title: Idle Transfiguration
1.description: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

1.title: Narrow-minded
1.description: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

1.title: To You, Someday
1.description: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

1.title: Tomorrow
1.description: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
1.description: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
1.description: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
1.description: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
1.description: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

1.title: Sage
1.description: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

1.title: Black Flash
1.description: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

1.title: Nonstandard
1.description: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

1.title: Jujutsu Koshien
1.description: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

1.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
1.description: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

1.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
1.description: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

1.title: Accomplices
1.description: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

2.title: Hidden Inventory
2.description: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

2.title: Hidden Inventory 2
2.description: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

2.title: Hidden Inventory 3
2.description: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

2.title: Hidden Inventory 4
2.description: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

2.title: Premature Death
2.description: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

2.title: It's Like That
2.description: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

2.title: Evening Festival
2.description: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

2.title: Shibuya Incident
2.description: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

2.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
2.description: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

2.title: Pandemonium
2.description: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

2.title: Seance
2.description: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

2.title: Dull Knife
2.description: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

2.title: Red Scale
2.description: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

2.title: Fluctuations
2.description: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

2.title: Fluctuations (2)
2.description: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

2.title: Thunderclap
2.description: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

2.title: Thunderclap (2)
2.description: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

2.title: Right and Wrong
2.description: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

2.title: Right and Wrong (2)
2.description: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

2.title: Right and Wrong (3)
2.description: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

2.title: Metamorphosis
2.description: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

2.title: Metamorphosis (2)
2.description: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

2.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
2.description: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

3.title: Execution
3.description: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

3.title: One More Time
3.description: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

3.title: About the Culling Game
3.description: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

3.title: Perfect Preparation
3.description: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

3.title: Passion
3.description: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

3.title: Cog
3.description: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1
3.description: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (2)
3.description: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (3)
3.description: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (4)
3.description: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (5)
3.description: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

3.title: Sendai Colony
3.description: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

1.title: Let You Down
1.description: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

1.title: Like a Boy
1.description: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

1.title: Smooth Criminal
1.description: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

1.title: Lucky You
1.description: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

1.title: All Eyez on Me
1.description: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

1.title: Girl on Fire
1.description: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

1.title: Stronger
1.description: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

1.title: Stay
1.description: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

1.title: Humanity
1.description: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

1.title: My Moon My Man
1.description: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

1.title: SONNIE'S EDGE
1.description: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

1.title: THREE ROBOTS
1.description: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

1.title: THE WITNESS
1.description: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

1.title: SUITS
1.description: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

1.title: SUCKER OF SOULS
1.description: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

1.title: WHEN THE YOGURT TOOK OVER
1.description: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

1.title: BEYOND THE AQUILA RIFT
1.description: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

1.title: GOOD HUNTING
1.description: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

1.title: THE DUMP
1.description: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

1.title: SHAPE-SHIFTERS
1.description: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

1.title: HELPING HAND
1.description: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

1.title: FISH NIGHT
1.description: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

1.title: LUCKY 13
1.description: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

1.title: ZIMA BLUE
1.description: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

1.title: BLINDSPOT
1.description: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

1.title: ICE AGE
1.description: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

1.title: ALTERNATE HISTORIES
1.description: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

1.title: THE SECRET WAR
1.description: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

2.title: Automated Customer Service
2.description: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

2.title: Ice
2.description: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

2.title: Pop Squad
2.description: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

2.title: Snow in the Desert
2.description: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

2.title: The Tall Grass
2.description: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

2.title: All Through the House
2.description: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

2.title: Life Hutch
2.description: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

2.title: The Drowned Giant
2.description: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

3.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
3.description: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

3.title: Bad Travelling
3.description: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

3.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
3.description: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

3.title: Night of the Mini Dead
3.description: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

3.title: Kill Team Kill
3.description: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

3.title: Swarm
3.description: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

3.title: Mason's Rats
3.description: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

3.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
3.description: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

3.title: Jibaro
3.description: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

4.title: Can't Stop
4.description: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

4.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
4.description: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

4.title: Spider Rose
4.description: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

4.title: 400 Boys
4.description: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

4.title: The Other Large Thing
4.description: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

4.title: Golgotha
4.description: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

4.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
4.description: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

4.title: How Zeke Got Religion
4.description: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

4.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
4.description: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

4.title: For He Can Creep
4.description: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

1.title: The National Anthem
1.description: Prime Minister Michael Callow faces a shocking dilemma when Princess Susannah, a much-loved member of the Royal Family, is kidnapped.

1.title: Fifteen Million Merits
1.description: After failing to impress the judges on a singing competition show, a woman must either perform degrading acts or return to a slave-like existence.

1.title: The Entire History of You
1.description: In the near future, everyone has access to a memory implant that records everything humans do, see and hear.

2.title: Be Right Back
2.description: After learning about a new service that lets people stay in touch with the deceased, a lonely, grieving Martha reconnects with her late lover.

2.title: White Bear
2.description: Victoria wakes up and cannot remember anything about her life. Everyone she encounters refuses to communicate with her.

2.title: The Waldo Moment
2.description: A failed comedian who voices a popular cartoon bear named Waldo finds himself mixing in politics when TV executives want Waldo to run for office.

2.title: White Christmas
2.description: In a mysterious and remote snowy outpost, Matt and Potter share a Christmas meal together, swapping creepy tales of their earlier lives in the outside world.

3.title: Nosedive
3.description: A woman desperate to boost her social media score hits the jackpot when she's invited to a swanky wedding. But the trip doesn't go as planned.

3.title: Playtest
3.description: An American traveler short on cash signs up to test a revolutionary new gaming system, only to discover the thrills are a little too real.

3.title: Shut Up and Dance
3.description: After a virus infects his laptop, a teen faces a daunting choice: carry out orders delivered by text message, or risk having intimate secrets exposed.

3.title: San Junipero
3.description: In a seaside town in 1987, a shy young woman and an outgoing party girl strike up a powerful bond that seems to defy the laws of space and time.

3.title: Men Against Fire
3.description: After his first battle with an elusive enemy, a soldier begins experiencing unfamiliar sensations and strange technical glitches.

3.title: Hated in the Nation
3.description: The death of a journalist at the center of a social media firestorm leads a veteran detective and her tech-savvy apprentice to a chilling discovery.

4.title: USS Callister
4.description: Capt. Robert Daly presides over his crew with wisdom and courage. But a new recruit will soon discover nothing on this spaceship is what it seems.

4.title: Arkangel
4.description: Worried about her daughter's safety, single mom Marie signs up for a cutting-edge device that monitors the girl's whereabouts -- and much more.

4.title: Crocodile
4.description: Architect Mia scrambles to keep a dark secret under wraps, while insurance investigator Shazia harvests people's memories of a nearby accident scene.

4.title: Hang the DJ
4.description: Paired up by a dating program that puts an expiration date on all relationships, Frank and Amy soon begin to question the system's logic.

4.title: Metalhead
4.description: At an abandoned warehouse, scavengers searching for supplies encounter a ruthless foe and flee for their lives through a bleak wasteland.

4.title: Black Museum
4.description: On a dusty stretch of highway, a traveler stumbles across a museum that boasts rare criminal artifacts -- and a disturbing main attraction.

5.title: Striking Vipers
5.description: When old college friends Danny and Karl reconnect in a VR version of their favorite video game, the late-night sessions yield an unexpected discovery.

5.title: Smithereens
5.description: A London rideshare driver ignites an international crisis when he kidnaps a worker from a social media company.

5.title: Rachel, Jack and Ashley Too
5.description: A lonely teen becomes obsessed with a robot doll based on her pop star idol, Ashley O - just as the real Ashley's life begins to unravel.

6.title: Joan Is Awful
6.description: An average woman discovers a global streaming service has adapted her daily life — and her secrets — into a drama starring A-list actress Salma Hayek.

6.title: Loch Henry
6.description: While filming a nature documentary in a sleepy Scottish town, a young couple catches wind of a juicy local story with ties to shocking past events.

6.title: Beyond the Sea
6.description: In an alternative 1969, two astronauts on a perilous high-tech space mission grapple with the fallout of an unfathomable tragedy back on Earth.

6.title: Mazey Day
6.description: A troubled Hollywood starlet goes to great lengths to escape packs of invasive paparazzi as she deals with the aftermath of a hit-and-run.

6.title: Demon 79
6.description: Northern England, 1979. A meek sales assistant discovers she must commit terrible acts to prevent an imminent disaster.

7.title: Common People
7.description: When a teacher is left fighting for her life, her doting husband signs her up for a high-tech system that keeps her alive — but at a cost.

7.title: Bête Noire
7.description: A young woman is unnerved when an old acquaintance joins the company she works at — especially as there's something odd about her that only she can see.

7.title: Hotel Reverie
7.description: A high-tech remake of a classic film sends its A-list star into another dimension, where she must stick to the script if she ever wants to make it home.

7.title: Plaything
7.description: In a near-future London, an eccentric murder suspect is linked to an unusual video game from the '90s — which hosts a society of digital life forms.

7.title: Eulogy
7.description: An isolated man is introduced to a groundbreaking system that allows users to step inside old photos — stirring powerful emotions in the process.

7.title: USS Callister: Into Infinity
7.description: Nanette Cole and the crew of the USS Callister are stranded in an infinite virtual universe, fighting for survival against 30 million players.

1.title: Good News About Hell
1.description: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

1.title: Half Loop
1.description: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

1.title: In Perpetuity
1.description: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon’s misdeeds.

1.title: The You You Are
1.description: Irving finds an intriguing book at work. Helly aggressively pursues a meeting with her Outie. Mark attends a funeral with Ms. Selvig.

1.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
1.description: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

1.title: Hide and Seek
1.description: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

1.title: Defiant Jazz
1.description: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

1.title: What's for Dinner?
1.description: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken’s party.

1.title: The We We Are
1.description: The team discovers troubling revelations.

2.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
2.description: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

2.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
2.description: Mark contemplates the meaning of a message.

2.title: Who Is Alive?
2.description: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

2.title: Woe's Hollow
2.description: The team participates in a group activity.

2.title: Trojan's Horse
2.description: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

2.title: Attila
2.description: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

2.title: Chikhai Bardo
2.description: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

2.title: Sweet Vitriol
2.description: Discoveries are made.

2.title: The After Hours
2.description: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

2.title: Cold Harbor
2.description: Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.

1.title: We Is Us
1.description: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

1.title: Pirate Lady
1.description: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together...and causes friction.

1.title: Grenade
1.description: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

1.title: Please, Carol
1.description: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.

1.title: Got Milk
1.description: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.

1.title: HDP
1.description: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.

1.title: The Gap
1.description: Manousos begins a dangerous trek to meet Carol. Returning home from Las Vegas, Carol gets creative with her rebellion.

1.title: Charm Offensive
1.description: Carol takes a different tack with The Others and discovers more than she anticipated. Manousos awakens in unfamiliar surroundings.

1.title: La Chica o El Mundo
1.description: Manousos arrives in Albuquerque and complications ensue. Carol visits the last best place on Earth.

1.title: The Gang Gets Racist
1.description: The guys hire Dee's friend, Terrell to promote the bar.  Meanwhile, Charlie tries to prove that he is not a racist.

1.title: Charlie Wants an Abortion
1.description: A girl from Charlie's past reveals they have a child together.  Mac sees the benefits in being a pro-life advocate, while Dennis uses an abortion rally to meet women.

1.title: Underage Drinking: A National Concern
1.description: After reminiscing about high school, the guys conclude that it would be a public service if they allowed teens to drink in the bar, thus providing a safe and controlled environment for teens to party. Feeling that she missed out on a lot as a teenager due to having to wear a brace for her scoliosis, Dee begins dating a high school jock.

1.title: Charlie Has Cancer
1.description: After discovering that he might have cancer, Mac and Dennis attempt to find a woman who will sleep with Charlie.  In the midst of their search, Mac falls in love with a transsexual he meets at the bar named Carmen.  Overwhelmed by the extra workload that she had to take on since Charlie has taken a leave of absence, Dee tries to get Dennis to hire a recently out of work actress friend to help out.

1.title: Gun Fever
1.description: The guys buy a gun after the bar's safe is stolen.

1.title: The Gang Finds a Dead Guy
1.description: Mac and Dennis befriend a patron found dead at their bar in order to win the affection of his granddaughter.

1.title: Charlie Got Molested
1.description: Charlie and Mac's old high school gym teacher is accused of molestation.

2.title: Charlie Gets Crippled
2.description: An accident that puts Charlie in a wheelchair opens up a window of possibilities for the gang. Meanwhile, Dennis and Dee’s estranged father reenters their life in hopes of starting anew with his children and soon discovers that he enjoys the lifestyle of their friends.

2.title: The Gang Goes Jihad
2.description: When the gang learns that they are in danger of losing their bar due to a zoning mishap, they resort to some outlandish and extreme methods to prevent that from happening. Meanwhile, Frank isn’t too happy when his wife returns to town.

2.title: Dennis and Dee Go on Welfare
2.description: After quitting their job due to Frank's continuing interference, Dennis and Dee decide to seek alternative income by going on welfare. Meanwhile, Mac and Charlie must now bear the consequences of their friends’ departures from the business.

2.title: Mac Bangs Dennis' Mom
2.description: Barbara hooks up with Mac to make Frank jealous, which leads to retaliation from Dennis.

2.title: Hundred Dollar Baby
2.description: Frank runs into an old adversary at the gym when he begins teaching Dee to box after she was robbed. Hoping to make some extra money on the side, Mac and Dennis make preparations for Charlie to compete in an underground street fighting match.

2.title: The Gang Gives Back
2.description: After being arrested for arson the gang is sentenced to do community service. Frank makes an effort to connect more with Dennis. Meanwhile, Charlie is also ordered to attend AA where he makes a startling discovery that might be beneficial in his ongoing quest to hook up with the Waitress.

2.title: The Gang Exploits a Miracle
2.description: Mac and Dee become uncomfortable when the rest of the guys decide to make some extra money by exploiting the similarities between a water stain and the Virgin Mary. A reunion with someone from the past, stirs up forbidden feelings within Dee.

2.title: The Gang Runs for Office
2.description: Driven by Frank's insight into the world of politics, Dennis pursues a political career by running for office.

2.title: Charlie Goes America All Over Everybody's Ass
2.description: Dennis and Mac make a decision to take away all rules concerning moral and behavioral etiquette at Paddy's after an argument about the Constitution. Frank uses the decision and it's following consequences to his own gain. Meanwhile, Charlie tries to convey his love for America by protesting while Dee attempts to reaffirm her goal of being an actress.

2.title: Dennis and Dee Get a New Dad
2.description: Dee receives e-mails from a stranger claiming to be her and Dennis' real father. Meanwhile, Mac decides to visit his father who is in prison.

3.title: The Gang Finds a Dumpster Baby
3.description: Dennis joins up with an environmentalist group, but his altruistic intentions quickly sour when he's snubbed by the activists. Dee and Mac decide to raise a baby they find in the dumpster, but quickly find out that it's not nearly as fun as they thought it would be, and Frank and Charlie take the concept of recycling a bit too far.

3.title: The Gang Gets Invincible
3.description: Mac, Dennis and Dee try out for the Philadelphia Eagles.  Also interested in becoming an Eagle is Liam and Ryan McPoyle's brother, Doyle.

3.title: Dennis and Dee's Mom Is Dead
3.description: After Barbara's death, Dee and Frank are unhappy to learn that she left them both out of the will, while Dennis inherits the mansion which he plans to turn into a party pad.

3.title: The Gang Gets Held Hostage
3.description: The McPoyles hold the entire gang hostage at Paddys while Frank is busy searching for his will in the air ducts.

3.title: The Aluminum Monster vs. Fatty Magoo
3.description: Dee is shocked to learn that an overweight social outcast from her High School has become a rich and skinny fashion designer.

3.title: The Gang Solves the North Korea Situation
3.description: A Korean restaurant owner threatens to get Paddy's kicked off the route for the city's annual pub crawl. The gang's response: War.

3.title: The Gang Sells Out
3.description: The gang agrees to sell Paddys when they get an offer that is too good to refuse, but it forces the bar's non-partners, Dee and Charlie to find new jobs.

3.title: Frank Sets Sweet Dee On Fire
3.description: Mac teams up with Frank and Charlie to create a public access newscast after he misses his chance at fame in the news. Meanwhile, Dennis and Dee try to make it big in the club scene.

3.title: Sweet Dee's Dating a Retarded Person
3.description: Dee gets involved with a famous local rapper who might be mentally challenged, and whose success inspires the rest of the gang to start a band.

3.title: Mac Is a Serial Killer
3.description: After Mac arrives to the bar with scratches on his neck and exhibiting strange behavior, Frank comes to the conclusion that he is the serial killer terrorizing young women in Philadelphia. Frank sets out with his trusty chainsaw and a doubtful Charlie to find evidence to implicate Mac in the murders. In search of another suspect, Dennis and Dee do a little role-playing in order to help themselves better understand who they might be dealing with.

3.title: Dennis Looks Like a Registered Sex Offender
3.description: When Dennis is mistaken for a recently released child molester, he is more bothered by the fact that the guy is overweight rather than him being a sex offender.  Meanwhile, Mac tries once again to bond with his ex-con father, who shows an interest in Dee.

3.title: The Gang Gets Whacked (1)
3.description: After stumbling upon a kilo of cocaine, the gang is forced to pay off a $25,000 debt to the mob. Mac becomes a mob informant, while Frank pimps out Dennis as an escort at the local country club. Charlie stumbles upon an opportunity to sell illegal narcotics.

3.title: The Gang Gets Whacked (2)
3.description: While paying off their debt to the mob, Charlie and Dee try to find a way to make fake cocaine in order to fool them, while Dennis ranks in thousands of dollars being pimped out at the local country club. Mac realizes his position as a mob informant isn't being utilized to its full potential.

3.title: Bums: Making a Mess All Over the City
3.description: Mac and Dee become vigilantes in order to remove the homeless from their neighborhood, while Frank and Dennis impersonate police officers.

3.title: The Gang Dances Their Asses Off
3.description: In the season finale, Charlie accidentally puts Paddy's up as a prize for a dance marathon, which prompts the gang to enter the competition in order to save their bar.

4.title: Mac and Dennis: Manhunters
4.description: Charlie and Dee have been stealing Frank's delicious meats, so Frank leaves out human meat to get back at them. Driven by their cannibalistic needs, Charlie and Dee go in search of human flesh. Mac and Dennis harass Frank for hunting defenseless animals and think it would be much more badass to hunt something that could fight back ... like a human.

4.title: The Gang Solves the Gas Crisis
4.description: Charlie, Mac, and Dennis formulate a plan to take advantage of the rising gas prices. By purchasing excess amounts now, they can sell it in the future and profit. As usual, things don't go as planned. Dee is also out to make money when she learns that Bruce is going to give the family fortune to a Muslim cultural center. She and Frank try to stop him and get the cash for themselves.

4.title: America’s Next Top Paddy’s Billboard Model Contest
4.description: Due to the gang's latest "business expenses," Paddy's is in dire need of money. Frank buys a billboard to advertise the bar, but Dee decides to create a viral video to post on YouTube for promotion. Charlie quickly joins her, leaving Frank and Mac to hold a contest for some hot models to feature on the billboard. Naturally, Dennis joins the competition to prove his worth.

4.title: Mac’s Banging the Waitress
4.description: Charlie finds out that the waitress has been seeing someone. He calls on Mac, his so-called best friend, to find out more information about the guy and to beat him up. However, it turns out that Mac is the guy the waitress has supposedly been seeing. Dennis, heartbroken that he's not Charlie's best friend, tries to win him over.

4.title: Mac and Charlie Die (1)
4.description: Part 1 of 2. Mac and Charlie fake their deaths to avoid the wrath of Mac's father who was released from prison and is out for vengeance.

4.title: Mac and Charlie Die (2)
4.description: Part 2 of 2. Dennis, Frank, and Dee find unique ways of coping with the apparent loss of their friends.

4.title: Who Pooped the Bed?
4.description: Charlie and Frank awake to find poop in their bed. Neither will confess to being the owner, so they, Mac, and Dennis try to scientifically deduce who dropped the deuce. Dee wants to do something a bit more sophisticated, so she invites the waitress and Artemis to a girls' night out.

4.title: Paddy’s Pub: The Worst Bar in Philadelphia
4.description: A newspaper critic is kidnapped by the gang after he calls Paddy's pub the worst bar in Philadelphia.

4.title: Dennis Reynolds: An Erotic Life
4.description: After discovering Dennis' erotic memoir, Mac and Frank attempt to make some money off of it. Meanwhile, Dee and Charlie decide to spend a day in each other's shoes.

4.title: Sweet Dee Has a Heart Attack
4.description: After Dee suffers a heart attack, she and Dennis try to live a healthier lifestyle. Meanwhile, Charlie and Mac take corporate jobs to get health insurance.

4.title: The Gang Cracks the Liberty Bell
4.description: The gang fudge history by claiming that Paddy's Pub was responsible for cracking the Liberty Bell in an attempt to turn their dive into a Philadelphia landmark.

4.title: The Gang Gets Extreme: Home Makeover Edition
4.description: Hoping to make their own dreams come true, the gang sets out to give an unexpected family an extreme home makeover.

4.title: The Nightman Cometh
4.description: In the season finale, Charlie gets the gang to help him put together a rock opera based on his song "Nightman."

5.title: The Gang Exploits the Mortgage Crisis
5.description: Dennis, Mac, and Frank go into real estate, while Dee sets out to be a surrogate for a wealthy couple. Charlie gets into it with an attorney over the law.

5.title: The Gang Hits the Road
5.description: The gang tries to expand their horizons by going on a road trip to the Grand Canyon.

5.title: The Great Recession
5.description: With a shantytown taking shape outside, Mac and Dennis try to keep Paddy's going in tough times. Meanwhile, Frank and Dee start a family business.

5.title: The Gang Gives Frank an Intervention
5.description: Frank's behavior is more bizarre than usual---so bizarre that even the gang notice---so they decide to stage an intervention.

5.title: The Waitress Is Getting Married
5.description: The waitress is getting married, Dee is jealous that she's beating her to the altar, so she tries to derail the wedding.

5.title: The World Series Defense
5.description: The gang describes the trials and tribulations they went through, during game five of the World Series, in hopes the judge will clear them of all the citations they received.

5.title: The Gang Wrestles for the Troops
5.description: The gang puts together a wrestling show for returning troops. Meanwhile, Dee finally meets the soldier that she has been communicating with over the internet.

5.title: Paddy's Pub: Home of the Original Kitten Mittens
5.description: The gang decides to expand their business by developing a number of products that they could sell at Paddy's pub.

5.title: Mac and Dennis Break Up
5.description: Mac and Dennis decide that they need to spend some time away from each other. Meanwhile, Charlie helps Dee search for her cat.

5.title: The D.E.N.N.I.S. System
5.description: Dennis reveals his foolproof system for seducing any woman to the rest of the gang, but they don't grasp the concept.

5.title: Mac and Charlie Write a Movie
5.description: When Dee gets a part in the new M. Night Shyamalan film, Mac and Charlie seize a chance to pitch their movie script.

5.title: The Gang Reignites the Rivalry
5.description: After being banned for 10 years from a local drinking competition appropriately named "Flipadelphia," the gang tries to reignite their old rivalry with another local bar. Finding that they are in need of some serious practice, the guys head to Dennis' old fraternity house at the University of Pennsylvania to get their game up to speed while Dee hones her skills on her own. Frank wears skinny pants.

6.title: Mac Fights Gay Marriage
6.description: Mac defends traditional marriage, while the rest of the gang reaps the rewards of wedded bliss.

6.title: Dennis Gets Divorced
6.description: Marital bliss turns into business, as the gang experiences the emotional and economic hardships of divorce.

6.title: The Gang Buys a Boat
6.description: The gang attempts to find adventure on the sea after they purchase their 'new' boat.

6.title: Mac's Big Break
6.description: Mac finally gets his big break after correctly answering a trivia question on the radio. While Frank, Dennis, and Dee take their bar-banter to the internet with their own podcast.

6.title: Mac and Charlie: White Trash
6.description: Rejected from a pool club, Mac and Charlie set out fix an abandoned pool to help cope with the Philly heat wave. Meanwhile, Dennis and Dee go about dealing with the heat in a different way.

6.title: Mac's Mom Burns Her House Down
6.description: Mac's mother is left homeless after she burns down her house, which leaves Charlie and Mac with no choice but to make new living arrangements; when Dee feels under the weather, Frank tries to muster his paternal instincts to care for her.

6.title: Who Got Dee Pregnant?
6.description: The gang gets a real scare after Dee reveals she's pregnant, forcing the guys to recall their last hazy Halloween party to determine who the father is.

6.title: The Gang Gets a New Member
6.description: A blast from the past prompts the guys to expand membership, and Dee to re-consider her future.

6.title: Dee Reynolds: Shaping America's Youth
6.description: Motivated by the drama teacher who inspired her, Dee takes a job as a substitute teacher, and exposes her students to the culture of Paddy's with a field trip to see the Gang's take on the Lethal Weapon series: Lethal Weapon 5.

6.title: Charlie Kelly: King of the Rats
6.description: Keeping the basement rodent-free drives Charlie to the brink. The gang throws Charlie a surprise party.

6.title: The Gang Gets Stranded in the Woods
6.description: En route to Atlantic City for a charity event, Mac, Frank and Dee get lost. Meanwhile, Dennis and Charlie hitch a ride to town.

6.title: Dee Gives Birth
6.description: Dee's blessed event is fast approaching but the father's identity remains a mystery---to the gang, at least. So they throw a party and invite all of Dee's former flings.

6.title: A Very Sunny Christmas
6.description: After years of being mistreated by Frank during the holiday season, Dennis and Dee decide to teach him a lesson. Meanwhile, Mac and Charlie reflect on their childhood Christmases, and realize that they were not as joyous and wonderful as they remembered.

7.title: Frank's Pretty Woman
7.description: With Frank intent on marrying a prostitute, The Gang tries to make the best of it by attempting an image makeover to uncover the heart of gold that exists deep inside Frank’s “pretty woman.”

7.title: The Gang Goes to the Jersey Shore
7.description: Dee and Dennis take the gang to their favorite childhood vacation spot where things aren't quite how they remember. While Dee and Dennis see the seedy side of the Jersey Shore, Mac, Frank and Charlie have the nights of their lives.

7.title: Frank Reynolds' Little Beauties
7.description: Frank finds himself in the child beauty-pageant business and fears that people might think that he's in it for the wrong reasons. Meanwhile, Dee wages war on stage moms, and Mac, Dennis and Charlie think they have found a contestant to back.

7.title: Sweet Dee Gets Audited
7.description: Dee faces an IRS audit over her claim that the baby she carried as a surrogate is her dependent, while the guys decide to run the bar in an unemotional, democratic manner rather than their typical method of shouting and personal attacks.

7.title: Frank's Brother
7.description: When Frank's long lost brother Gino shows up at the bar, the two of them tell the gang about the jazz club they ran in the 1960s and 70s, and how they fell out over Shadynasty, a singer who was the love of both of their lives.

7.title: The Storm of the Century
7.description: As a hurricane threatens Philadelphia, Mac, Dennis and Charlie go to a mall to buy supplies and check out the large breasted TV reporter broadcasting from there, while Frank and Dee prepare Paddy's, and its basement bunker, for the storm.

7.title: Chardee MacDennis: The Game of Games
7.description: The gang plays the most twisted board game ever. Dee and Dennis face Mac, Charlie and Frank.

7.title: The ANTI-Social Network
7.description: The gang uses the Internet to cyber-stalk their prey. Frank tries to drum up business for Paddy's with a viral video.

7.title: The Gang Gets Trapped
7.description: The Gang's plan to "extract" an "artifact" from a residence is jeopardized when the owners turn out to be home. Having not been noticed on the way in, they must make a plan to get the same result for the way out.

7.title: How Mac Got Fat
7.description: Step inside the confession booth with Mac as he tells a befuddled priest why his fatness is the fault of the other members of The Gang.

7.title: Thunder Gun Express
7.description: Traffic problems as a result of the President's visit to Philadelphia makes it difficult for the gang to see the summer's biggest film, "Thunder Gun Express".

7.title: The High School Reunion (1)
7.description: The gang have much to prove when they attend their high-school reunion. They meet old friends and make new foes as they stroll down memory lane.

7.title: The High School Reunion (2): The Gang's Revenge
7.description: The gang come up with a new plan to buff their tarnished high-school reputations at their reunion.

8.title: Pop-Pop: The Final Solution
8.description: Dennis and Dee's ailing grandfather Pop-Pop is wasting away in the hospital, and they have to decide whether or not to pull the plug. But things get complicated when The Gang learns of Pop-Pop's history as a Nazi, and Mac, Charlie and Frank set off in search of the old man's spoils from the war.

8.title: The Gang Recycles Their Trash
8.description: With the garbage men of Philadelphia on strike, Frank concocts a plan to undercut the union and get the contract to collect the city's trash.

8.title: The Maureen Ponderosa Wedding Massacre
8.description: The gang make a disturbing discovery after crashing Maureen's wedding.

8.title: Charlie and Dee Find Love
8.description: Charlie and Dee become romantically involved with two members of a wealthy family, which arouses jealousy in Mac, Dennis and Frank.

8.title: The Gang Gets Analyzed
8.description: The Gang gets Freudian as they step into the therapist's office to work through their mountain of issues, but when Dennis thinks he has everyone figured out, the shrink turns the tables on him and exposes the insanity in his unique brand of pop psychology.

8.title: Charlie's Mom Has Cancer
8.description: Mac, Charlie and Dee struggle with their faith as Charlie's mom fights cancer. Meanwhile, Frank loses his memory amidst a search for buried treasure.

8.title: Frank's Back in Business
8.description: With Charlie under his wing, Frank cleans up so he can get his hands dirty and help out his old company with one last big merger. An unwritten rule of the bar gets the rest of the gang caught up in a case of mistaken identity.

8.title: Charlie Rules the World
8.description: After slipping into an unhealthy obsession with computer games, The Gang wrestles to define the difference between the real and the virtual worlds.

8.title: The Gang Dines Out
8.description: Every member of The Gang has something to celebrate at Guigino's, Philly's finest eatery, but when Mac and Dennis' private dinner is interrupted by an unexpected sighting of Frank and Charlie, the in-fighting begins. Dee also turns up at a table for one, and over the course of the night, the "one-ups-manship" soars to new heights.

8.title: Reynolds vs. Reynolds: The Cereal Defense
8.description: Court is in session at Paddy's Pub as Frank and Dennis present their cases to the rest of the gang, resulting in a verdict that will change their lives FOREVER... but not really.

9.title: The Gang Broke Dee
9.description: The gang attempts to cheer up a deeply depressed Dee, realizing they are the cause for her predicament.

9.title: Gun Fever Too: Still Hot
9.description: After Frank appears on Local Television advocating gun ownership, the rest of the gang takes a look at the ownership process and alternatives to find a common ground on this still heated issue.

9.title: The Gang Tries Desperately to Win an Award
9.description: Tired of failing to be recognized for their years of service in the bar industry, the gang changes their ways to give the patrons what they think they want.

9.title: Mac and Dennis Buy a Timeshare
9.description: The gang does their best to recoup their investments in questionable schemes by dumping their losses on Ben the soldier while trying to avoid being duped again by whatever mastermind is pulling their strings.

9.title: Mac Day
9.description: Everyone in the gang gets a day to do what they want while everyone else in the gang must participate willingly. This is Mac's Day... and its got twice the "Mac".

9.title: The Gang Saves the Day
9.description: A routine trip to a convenience store places the gang in the middle of an armed robbery.

9.title: The Gang Gets Quarantined
9.description: The gang voluntarily quarantine themselves inside of Paddy's in an attempt to keep their singing voices pristine for an upcoming competition when a severe flu outbreak sweeps Philadelphia.

9.title: Flowers for Charlie
9.description: When an experiment successfully multiplies Charlie's intellect and takes him away from the bar, the rest of the gang find themselves struggling to complete the menial "Charlie Work" that has kept the bar running for so long.

9.title: The Gang Makes Lethal Weapon 6
9.description: After creative differences over what constitutes tasteful nudity cause Frank to pull his money out of "Lethal Weapon 6" during filming, Mac, Dennis, and Charlie screen their rough footage for investors in hopes of raising enough capital to finish the production of their latest masterpiece.

9.title: The Gang Squashes Their Beefs
9.description: When some bad blood with old foes compromises their ideal Thanksgiving, the gang decides to make amends by breaking bread with those they've hurt.

10.title: The Gang Beats Boggs
10.description: Mac oversees the gang while they compete to break Wade Boggs’ legendary beer drinking record.

10.title: The Gang Group Dates
10.description: The gang gets into the online dating scene to expand their matchmaking potential.

10.title: Psycho Pete Returns
10.description: When Psycho Pete, long lost member of the freight train, is released from the mental hospital, Dennis and Dee rush to get him recommitted while Charlie and Mac attempt to restore him to his former hard-partying form.

10.title: Charlie Work
10.description: Charlie goes into overdrive when he's notified that the health inspector will be arriving that day. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang is trying to exploit a flaw in the air-miles reward system.

10.title: The Gang Spies Like U.S.
10.description: Dennis and Mac enlist Dee to spy on the fish factory across the street, Charlie and Frank grow suspicious and decide to do some spying of their own.

10.title: The Gang Misses the Boat
10.description: The group separates from one another to find out who they are as individuals after another failed endeavor.

10.title: Mac Kills His Dad
10.description: News surfaces about Mac's Dad, Luther, being a murder suspect. Mac goes into full "P.I." mode to clear his father of any wrong doing.

10.title: The Gang Goes on Family Fight
10.description: When the gang appears on a nationally broadcasted game show, Dennis does his best to keep the gang’s weirdness under wraps.

10.title: Frank Retires
10.description: Frank decides to retire; the foursome begin to plot and plan ways for each of them to take control of the bar.

10.title: Ass Kickers United: Mac and Charlie Join a Cult
10.description: "Asskickers" isn't just a hot new way to work out; it's a way of life...and maybe a cult.

11.title: Chardee MacDennis 2: Electric Boogaloo
11.description: The gang agrees to a truce while demonstrating Chardee MacDennis for an interested board game executive, but the nature of the game quickly sends things off the rails

11.title: Frank Falls Out the Window
11.description: Frank falls out the window causing him to think it's 2006, the gang approaches it as a do-over and attempts to fix their past mistakes.

11.title: The Gang Hits the Slopes
11.description: Dennis and Frank square off against Dee and Mac for control of the mountain, while Charlie learns that the slopes have their own set of rules.

11.title: Dee Made a Smut Film
11.description: Dennis and Dee film an adaptation of Dennis' erotic memoirs while Frank and Mac try to pass off Charlie as a gifted artist for financial gain.

11.title: Mac & Dennis Move to the Suburbs
11.description: Mac and Dennis move to the suburbs for cheaper rent but find it hard to adjust.

11.title: Being Frank
11.description: The gang have a new scheme and Frank tries to keep up.

11.title: McPoyle vs. Ponderosa: The Trial of the Century
11.description: Old grievances bubble to the surface when The Lawyer agrees to sue Bill Ponderosa on behalf of the Liam McPoyle and his lost eye.

11.title: Charlie Catches a Leprechaun
11.description: Dennis tries to create an innovative mobile Paddy's pub experience but runs into trouble when customers refuse to cooperate, while Charlie and Mac attempt to catch a thieving leprechaun.

11.title: The Gang Goes to Hell (1)
11.description: The gang tries to take a vacation from their usual dynamic by going on a cruise, but old habits die hard.

11.title: The Gang Goes to Hell (2)
11.description: The gang gets real with one another in the face of death.

12.title: The Gang Turns Black
12.description: After an electric heating blanket shorts out while the gang watches the Wiz they look in the mirror and realize they've turned black. They have to figure out how to get back to being themselves by going through all the classic body switch movie shenanigans they encounter.

12.title: The Gang Goes to a Water Park
12.description: The gang takes a trip to a local waterpark. Dennis takes on a protégé. Frank and Charlie are determined to ride every ride. Mac and Dee get stuck in a tube slide.

12.title: Old Lady House: A Situation Comedy
12.description: Charlie thinks Mac's mom is holding his mom hostage so the gang installs spy cameras in their house. They discover the moms are quite entertaining once Dennis makes edits to the footage.

12.title: Wolf Cola: A Public Relations Nightmare
