12.description: Franks Fluids LLC is in big trouble after a news segment. Dee and Dennis help with the PR nightmare and Charlie and Mac work on a scheme to make Fight Milk the official drink of the UFC.

12.title: Making Dennis Reynolds a Murderer
12.description: A cat-woman is killed and Dennis becomes the main suspect.

12.title: Hero or Hate Crime?
12.description: The gang fight over a lottery ticket and seek out an arbitrator to decide a rightful owner, who also decides if Frank is a hero or hate monger.

12.title: PTSDee
12.description: Dee dates a male stripper and tries to prove her worth after learning she's his "rock bottom." Elsewhere: Mac and Frank get sucked into a VR war game, leading Mac to develop a case PTSD.

12.title: The Gang Tends Bar
12.description: It’s Valentine’s Day and Paddy’s is packed with customers. Dennis implores the gang to do one day of actual work but everyone else is distracted by a mystery crate Cricket spotted in the alley. Eventually, the gang becomes convinced Dennis really wants them to work on their relationships and everyone shares their grievances without much resolution.

12.title: A Cricket's Tale
12.description: We get to see a typical day in Cricket's world and then a possible redemption when his family intervenes. Will Cricket finally move on from the gang, finding love in the process? Will Cricket go from filthy beast to his former self, Matthew Mara?

12.title: Dennis' Double Life
12.description: Dennis reveals he has a baby after his Wade Boggs layover in North Dakota and the gang try to help him get out of the jam, but their suggestions border on the extreme.

13.title: The Gang Makes Paddy's Great Again
13.description: Meet Cindy, the new, ethnically diverse female member of the gang who can successfully pull off scams. Everything is working until Mac introduces a new member: a life-like sex doll that looks exactly like Dennis.

13.title: The Gang Escapes
13.description: To boost productivity, Dee hires an at-home "Escape Room Experience" service to come to Dennis and Mac's apartment. Will they escape? Who will get the credit? What could go wrong?

13.title: The Gang Beats Boggs: Ladies Reboot
13.description: To one-up the guys, Dee has organized an "all-female reboot" of the Wade Boggs challenge on a first-of-its-kind, all-female flight headed to L.A. for the women's march.

13.title: Time's Up for the Gang
13.description: Paddy's has been put on a list of bars that are sexually hostile to women, and the gang must attend a sexual harassment seminar to get off the list.

13.title: The Gang Gets New Wheels
13.description: Dee gets in with a group of cool, rich housewives. Dennis hits it off with some everyday blue-collar bros. Frank struggles to renew his license, and Charlie and Mac deal with a new generation of bicycle bullies.

13.title: The Gang Solves the Bathroom Problem
13.description: Jimmy Buffett is in town and the positive vibes are alive at the bar. But when Mac comes out of the women's bathroom, no one can leave until the bathroom situation is solved.

13.title: The Gang Does a Clip Show
13.description: With nothing to do while their phones update to the latest software, the gang decides to reminisce on old times. As everyone misremembers events from their past, the gang's current reality becomes altered.

13.title: Charlie's Home Alone
13.description: It's the weekend of Super Bowl LII from Charlie's perspective. While Charlie searches the back office, Cricket steals the suit leaving Charlie home alone to defend himself.

13.title: The Gang Wins the Big Game
13.description: It’s the most important weekend of their lives and Frank has treated the gang and a crew of their ragtag hangers-on with tickets to see the Eagles in the Super Bowl!

13.title: Mac Finds His Pride
13.description: Frank tries to recruit Mac for the gang’s kickass float for the Gay Pride Parade. It dawns on Frank that Mac will never be secure with his sexual identity unless he comes out to his father.

14.title: The Gang Gets Romantic
14.description: Mac concocts a scheme to attract single women to Airbnb Dennis' bedroom, while Frank and Charlie concoct similar plans to attract young, European coeds. But neither ad attracts their intended target.

14.title: Thunder Gun 4: Maximum Cool
14.description: The Gang finds themselves in the middle of a focus group after a screening of Thunder Gun 4: Maximum Cool. They are determined to restore glory and traditional American values back into the franchise, even if it involves sabotage.

14.title: Dee Day
14.description: The Guys are in the final preparation stage for an unknown scheme when Dee excitedly enters to inform them that today is “Dee Day.” The guys have to do everything she wants without complaint.

14.title: The Gang Chokes
14.description: Annoyed that the Gang failed to react as he nearly choked to death on an appetizer, Frank decides the Waiter, his savior, is the only person who has his back.

14.title: The Gang Texts
14.description: During their trip to the Philadelphia Zoo, Mac sets up a text group chain for The Gang, but confusion sets in and The Gang must learn from the meerkats on how to communicate properly in a group.

14.title: The Janitor Always Mops Twice
14.description: In the black-and-white noir world of his memory, Charlie navigates the seedy underbelly of Philadelphia as Frank has been "diarrhea poisoned," and it's up to Charlie to clean up the mess.

14.title: The Gang Solves Global Warming
14.description: As a record-breaking heat wave overtakes Philly, the Gang plans to profit from global warming by pumping up the A/C so people will congregate at Paddy's and save energy at home.

14.title: Paddy's Has a Jumper
14.description: Trapped inside Paddy's with a suicide jumper on the roof, the Gang wonders if they should bother intervening with an algorithm of their own - Could he, would he, should we? the second half hour, Dennis and Charlie stand guard at the entrance to their laser tag base waiting to ambush the legendary "Big Mo," but Dennis begins to ponder the reasons they play laser tag and if their pursuit of a victory is worth their effort.

14.title: A Woman's Right to Chop
14.description: When a trendy new hair salon opens up right next door to Paddy's, Dennis and Frank go on the offensive to stop women from cutting off their hair. Meanwhile, Mac is reunited with his childhood dog Poppins..

14.title: Waiting for Big Mo
14.description: In this spoof of Waiting for Godot, Dennis and Charlie stand guard at their laser tag base waiting to ambush their enemy, Big Mo, but Dennis has doubts about why they play laser tag and whether or not the victory is worth it.

15.title: 2020: A Year in Review
15.description: The Gang looks back on 2020 to justify their numerous PPE loans. In doing so, it is revealed that they contributed to the chaos of the past political year way more than anyone could have imagined.

15.title: The Gang Makes Lethal Weapon 7
15.description: Upon discovering that their self-made Lethal Weapon sequels have been pulled from the local library, the Gang decides to address their political incorrectness by making another film — Lethal Weapon 7.

15.title: The Gang Buys a Roller Rink
15.description: In the past, an innocent Dennis learns the horrifying details of Frank's business, a truly sweet Dee is excited to head off for Hollywood, while Charlie and Mac's jobs at the roller rink are in jeopardy.

15.title: The Gang Replaces Dee with a Monkey
15.description: When the Gang suspects Dee is menopausal, they scramble to find a new employee for Paddy's Pub. Dee decides to put her acting career on hold in order to mentor young actors.

15.title: The Gang Goes to Ireland
15.description: The gang's in Dublin where Dennis ends up helping Frank with some of his business's dirty work. Mac and Charlie learn about their Irish heritage. Dee rushes to the set of an Irish soap opera, where she will play an "Obnoxious American MILF."

15.title: The Gang's Still in Ireland
15.description: Dennis and Dee explore their new accommodations in the countryside. Frank accompanies Charlie to find the truth about Charlie's Irish childhood pen pal. Mac has an identity crisis and decides to join the seminary.

15.title: Dee Sinks in a Bog
15.description: Mac spends a day at the seminary to truly understand what it takes to become a priest. Dennis and Frank plan an elaborate trap to humiliate Charlie's pen pal. Dee prepares for a date with an Irish doctor. Charlie bonds with his pen pal.

15.title: The Gang Carries a Corpse Up a Mountain
15.description: The Gang attempts to ascend a mountain in order for Charlie to fulfill an old and mysterious Irish burial tradition. One by one, the Gang backs out until Charlie is left to honor the dead body alone.

16.title: The Gang Inflates
16.description: Dennis and Mac get into inflatable furniture to deal with the economy’s inflation, while Dee tries to find a place to crash after being evicted by her greedy landlord and Charlie wants to pitch Frank his crypto/online investment idea. And in this inflation episode everything gets bigger - Dee’s desperation, Mac’s lips, and even Charlie’s apartment!

16.title: Frank Shoots Every Member of the Gang
16.description: After Frank shoots Dennis and Dee, they resolve to take Frank’s gun away. Mac and Charlie go on a road trip with their moms to get their inheritances -- for Mac, it’s letters written by his grandfather which have fallen into his Uncle Donald’s hands, while for Charlie, it’s a jar of teeth that is now in the hands of his sisters, Bunny and Candy.

16.title: The Gang Gets Cursed
16.description: The Gang’s going to be on Bar Rescue but a series of bad omens leads them to believe they are all cursed. They set off to undo the curses and make amends to those they’ve wronged, while Mac, who’s on a run of good luck, meets Chase Utley and invites him for a catch.

16.title: Frank vs. Russia
16.description: Charlie cheers on Frank at a local chess tournament against a Russian grandmaster. Dennis helps Mac and Dee find boyfriends after getting irritated by Mac’s current boyfriend, Johnny.

16.title: Celebrity Booze: The Ultimate Cash Grab
16.description: When news spreads of Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul’s visit to Philadelphia to promote their Dos Hermanos mezcal brand, the Guys decide to pitch them their own liquor. The Gang takes to the skies to get a taste of the glamorous high life.

16.title: Risk E. Rat's Pizza and Amusement Center
16.description: The gang goes to Risk E. Rat's, finding it updated with safety and overcautiousness. Dee takes Frank on a scavenger hunt to find risqué jokes hidden throughout the establishment. Mac plays Skee-Ball to win tickets for a prize.

16.title: The Gang Goes Bowling
16.description: The guys crash Dee's bowling league night and compete in a Battle of the Sexes at a bowling alley owned by the McPoyles. Dee, The Waitress, Artemis, and Gail the Snail versus Dennis, Mac, Charlie, and Frank in a classic match to prove who is better.

16.title: Dennis Takes a Mental Health Day
16.description: After a physical reveals Dennis has high blood pressure, he decides to take a day away from The Gang to de-stress at the beach. But life has other plans, and his day spirals into a string of mishaps until he can no longer contain his rage.

17.title: The Gang F***s Up Abbott Elementary
17.description: Months after the Gang visited, Abbott's Principal Ava walks viewers through some of the unseen footage of the Gang's volunteerism and reveals their true intentions.

17.title: Frank Is in a Coma
17.description: The five stages of grief set in for Dee as Frank lies on his deathbed. Meanwhile, the Guys plot their new path forward by pitching their business ventures to Philadelphia's elite.

17.title: Mac and Dennis Become EMTs
17.description: After witnessing EMTs resuscitate a Paddy's patron, Mac and Dennis set out to become the pinnacle of masculinity; Frank tries to prove a prank's innocence with The Lawyer; Dee attempts to hack her part-time side hustle with Charlie's help as he descends into the fast-paced life of a chef.

17.title: Thought Leadership: A Corporate Conversation
17.description: Desperate to stave off a public relations nightmare, the Gang embraces their newfound corporate professionalism to strategically scapegoat one Paddy's employee to fall on the proverbial sword.

17.title: The Gang Goes to a Dog Track
17.description: Frank attempts to win big with an old business associate at a West Virginia dog track; Dennis and Dee lose more than their shirts to gambling addiction; Mac and Charlie learn about a simpler way of life.

17.title: Overage Drinking: A National Concern
17.description: When Tammy and Trey, now in their 40s, show up to remove their teenage son from Paddy's, Dennis and Dee attempt to reconnect with their former prom dates. Frank's sudden disappearance sends Mac and Charlie on a mission to track down his whereabouts.

17.title: The Gang Gets Ready for Prime Time
17.description: Upon learning that Frank's making a "Hometown Visit" with his Golden Bachelor partners, the Gang rehearses their family dinner to appeal to America.

17.title: The Golden Bachelor Live
17.description: Host Jesse Palmer walks the audience through Frank's journey up until his final rose ceremony in the "Golden Bachelor" finale. But whom will he pick: a young internet celebrity, a confident woman his age, or a familiar face?

1.title: Where Is Everybody?
1.description: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

1.title: One for the Angels
1.description: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

1.title: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
1.description: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

1.title: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
1.description: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

1.title: Walking Distance
1.description: A stressed advertising executive, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child.

1.title: Escape Clause
1.description: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

1.title: The Lonely
1.description: In 2046, imprisoned for murder on a distant asteroid, Corry receives an unexpected present that brings a semblance of companionship during his isolation.

1.title: Time Enough at Last
1.description: A bank teller, obsessed with reading, faces conflicts at work and home because of his passion for literature.

1.title: Perchance to Dream
1.description: A man with a heart condition explains to his psychiatrist that he feels extremely tired, because he is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

1.title: Judgment Night
1.description: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there.

1.title: And When the Sky Was Opened
1.description: Recovering in the hospital after a space mission, Major William Gart is visited by his co-pilot Lieutenant Colonel Clegg Forbes, who insists on the existence of a third astronaut.

1.title: What You Need
1.description: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

1.title: The Four of Us are Dying
1.description: In this noirish tale, a man with the ability to change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

1.title: Third from the Sun
1.description: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

1.title: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
1.description: Three astronauts crash-land on an unknown planet and must confront survival challenges, unraveling their unity in the face of desperation.

1.title: The Hitch-Hiker
1.description: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually encounters the same mysterious hitch-hiker who inexplicably reappears at various points in her journey.

1.title: The Fever
1.description: Tight fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas.  But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

1.title: The Last Flight
1.description: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. air base in the year 1959!

1.title: The Purple Testament
1.description: Lieutenant Fitzgerald, serving in World War II, possesses the disquieting ability to foresee impending death by observing a strange glow on the faces of his men before battle.

1.title: Elegy
1.description: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

1.title: Mirror Image
1.description: In a bus depot, Millicent Barnes experiences odd events, leading to concerns about her sanity.

1.title: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
1.description: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

1.title: A World of Difference
1.description: Arthur Curtis, a successful businessman sitting in his office discovers that he is on a film set and everyone refers to him as Gerry Reagan, a movie star struggling with alcoholism and a declining career.

1.title: Long Live Walter Jameson
1.description: Walter Jameson, a popular history professor, is suspected by his fiancée's father, another professor at the college, to be an immortal.

1.title: People are Alike All Over
1.description: After a space exploration crash-lands on Mars, the lone surviving astronaut is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking and friendly.

1.title: Execution
1.description: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, an outlaw cowboy in 1880 is transported into the future.

1.title: The Big Tall Wish
1.description: Washed-up boxer Bolie Jackson, with the help of a special wish from his young friend Henry, miraculously switches places with his opponent during a comeback fight, turning the tide in his favor.

1.title: A Nice Place to Visit
1.description: After being shot to death, the criminal Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip in the afterlife, who gives him everything he wishes for.

1.title: Nightmare as a Child
1.description: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment, who tries to jog Helen's memory about a man she saw earlier that day.

1.title: A Stop at Willoughby
1.description: Riding home on the train one day, a stressed businessman falls asleep and dreams it is 1888, and he is entering a small, idyllic town called Willoughby.

1.title: The Chaser
1.description: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, seeks the help of an old professor, who provides him with a love potion.

1.title: A Passage for Trumpet
1.description: A down-and-out trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

1.title: Mr. Bevis
1.description: After losing his job, his car and his apartment on the same day, an eccentric loser gets a new lease on life from his guardian angel, but there is a price for keeping it.

1.title: The After Hours
1.description: Puzzled and unsettled by the odd behavior of the salespeople, a woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist.

1.title: The Mighty Casey
1.description: A baseball manager takes his team to the championships thanks to a robot pitcher.

1.title: A World of His Own
1.description: Coming home, Victoria catches her husband Gregory flirting with a beautiful woman in his study. His explanation that characters come to life before his eyes when he speaks into his dictation machine, leads Victoria to question his sanity.

2.title: King Nine Will Not Return
2.description: A WWII captain finds himself in the desert, next to his crashed plane, and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

2.title: The Man in the Bottle
2.description: A discontented curio shop owner thinks he's finally found happiness when a genie he discovers in an old bottle grants him four wishes.

2.title: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
2.description: Ordered to commit a murder he doesn't want to perform, a smalltime hood nervously looks in the mirror and sees the man he could have been--confident, strong...and determined to get out.

2.title: A Thing About Machines
2.description: A writer feels that the machines in his house are conspiring against him.

2.title: The Howling Man
2.description: A man on a walking trip of post-World War I Europe gets caught in a storm. He comes across a remote monastery with a mysterious prisoner.

2.title: Eye of the Beholder
2.description: A young woman lying in a hospital bed awaits the outcome of an experimental treatment in an attempt to make her look normal.

2.title: Nick of Time
2.description: A superstitious newlywed becomes obsessed by a penny fortune-telling machine when he and his new wife are stranded with car trouble.

2.title: The Lateness of the Hour
2.description: Jana, the daughter of inventor Dr. Loren, struggles with her parents' reliance on lifelike robot servants, urging her father to dismantle them despite his attachment to his creations.

2.title: The Trouble with Templeton
2.description: Booth Templeton is an aging actor who longs for the old days when his wife was alive.  Miraculously, he is given a sobering glimpse of the past he holds so dear.

2.title: A Most Unusual Camera
2.description: Chester Diedrich and his wife Paula, after burglarizing a curio shop, end up with a camera that takes pictures of events five minutes into the future.

2.title: The Night of the Meek
2.description: A down-on-his-luck department store Santa Claus discovers a bottomless sack of toys.

2.title: Dust
2.description: After selling the rope for a hanging, a greedy peddler, tries to sell the condemned man's father a bag of "magic dust."

2.title: Back There
2.description: It's April 14, 1961. Peter Corrigan and friends are discussing time travel at their men's club. Corrigan suddenly becomes dizzy. When his head clears, he has moved back to April 14, 1865 - the date of Lincoln's assassination.

2.title: The Whole Truth
2.description: A peculiar Model A automobile compels a used car dealer to tell only the truth.

2.title: The Invaders
2.description: An old woman in an isolated farmhouse encounters tiny, hostile aliens.

2.title: A Penny for Your Thoughts
2.description: The lucky flip of a coin seems to give a mild-mannered bank clerk the power to read minds. But he soon learns that you can't believe everything you read.

2.title: Twenty Two
2.description: Miss Powell has a recurring nightmare about room 22 – a morgue.

2.title: The Odyssey of Flight 33
2.description: A commercial aircraft mysteriously travels back through time.

2.title: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
2.description: Martians give Luther Dingle the strength of 300 men.

2.title: Static
2.description: Ed Lindsay hates television, so he gets his old radio out of the basement of the boardinghouse where he lives. He soon finds he can receive programs from the past when he's alone.

2.title: The Prime Mover
2.description: Ace Larsen discovers his business partner has the ability to control objects with his mind. The pair head to Vegas to win big.

2.title: Long Distance Call
2.description: A young boy find he can communicate with his dead grandmother through a toy phone.

2.title: A Hundred Yards Over the Rim
2.description: In 1847 a western settler sets out to find medicine for his dying son - and stumbles into modern-day New Mexico.

2.title: The Rip Van Winkle Caper
2.description: Thieves put themselves into suspended animation for 100 years after hiding a million dollars worth of gold bars.

2.title: The Silence
2.description: A talkative man takes an offer to keep silent for a year for $500,000.

2.title: Shadow Play
2.description: Trapped in a recurring nightmare, a man tries to persuade those who are sentencing him to death that the whole scenario is not real.

2.title: The Mind and the Matter
2.description: A book on the power of thought enables an irritable worker to re-create the world exactly as he wants it. But what he wants and what he gets are two different things!

2.title: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up?
2.description: State Troopers follow the tracks from a frozen pond, into a diner. Inside they find a soda jerk, a bus driver and his seven passengers. The bus driver is certain only six people boarded his bus…

2.title: The Obsolete Man
2.description: In a future state where religion and books have been banned, a librarian is judged obsolete and sentenced to death.

3.title: Two
3.description: A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.

3.title: The Arrival
3.description: A plane lands safely, but all its passengers, pilot and crew are missing.

3.title: The Shelter
3.description: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

3.title: The Passersby
3.description: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

3.title: A Game of Pool
3.description: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

3.title: The Mirror
3.description: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

3.title: The Grave
3.description: Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.

3.title: It's a Good Life
3.description: On an isolated family farm in Peakesville, Ohio, young Anthony Fremont, who has vast mental powers but lacks emotional development, holds his terrified family and neighbors in thrall to his every juvenile wish.

3.title: Deaths-Head Revisited
3.description: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce, and is met by one of his victims.

3.title: The Midnight Sun
3.description: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

3.title: Still Valley
3.description: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

3.title: The Jungle
3.description: Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's voodoo doctor puts a curse on him.

3.title: Once Upon a Time
3.description: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time travelling helmet which transports him to 1962.

3.title: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
3.description: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

3.title: A Quality of Mercy
3.description: A gung ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

3.title: Nothing in the Dark
3.description: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

3.title: One More Pallbearer
3.description: Paul Radin has invited three people to join him in his bomb shelter.

3.title: Dead Man's Shoes
3.description: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

3.title: The Hunt
3.description: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

3.title: Showdown with Rance McGrew
3.description: The star of a Western TV series suddenly finds himself transported back in time to the real Wild West, and face-to-face with the real Jesse James.

3.title: Kick the Can
3.description: A retiree living in a rest home thinks he has discovered the secret of youth — acting young, and in particular playing a children's game called "kick-the-can".

3.title: A Piano in the House
3.description: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

3.title: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank
3.description: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...

3.title: To Serve Man
3.description: An alien race comes to Earth, promising peace and sharing technology. A team of linguists sets out to translate the aliens' language, using a book whose title they deduce to be "To Serve Man."

3.title: The Fugitive
3.description: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

3.title: Little Girl Lost
3.description: Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished, even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.

3.title: Person or Persons Unknown
3.description: David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.

3.title: The Little People
3.description: An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.

3.title: Four O'Clock
3.description: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

3.title: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
3.description: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

3.title: The Trade-Ins
3.description: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

3.title: The Gift
3.description: An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.

3.title: The Dummy
3.description: A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil.  He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy:  plans that Willie doesn't support!

3.title: Young Man's Fancy
3.description: When a newlywed couple briefly return to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

3.title: I Sing the Body Electric
3.description: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

3.title: Cavender is Coming
3.description: Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

3.title: The Changing of the Guard
3.description: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, made an effect on the lives of his students over the years.

4.title: In His Image
4.description: A scientist tries to correct his imperfections by building a mechanical likeness of himself, which includes of all the finer qualities he is lacking.

4.title: The Thirty-Fathom Grave
4.description: A US naval destroyer investigates a mysterious tapping sound coming from a sunken submarine.

4.title: Valley of the Shadow
4.description: A reporter finds himself trapped in a small town where people can reverse time and do many other amazing things.

4.title: He's Alive
4.description: A small American Neo-Nazi group struggles pathetically to succeed in a big city. A mysterious figure begins to guide their young, insecure leader, and the group begins to draw more attention.

4.title: Mute
4.description: A 12-year-old girl who lost her parents in a fire doesn't speak because she has grown up in a secret telepathic community. The couple who take her in, and her teacher, are determined to help her adapt to their society, no matter the cost.

4.title: Death Ship
4.description: A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own. Two of the crew are convinced that they are dead, but the captain refuses to see the truth.

4.title: Jess-Belle

4.title: Miniature
4.description: A lonely man falls in love with a mini museum doll, which he believes is alive.

4.title: Printer's Devil
4.description: A wily old man, hired by a bankrupt newspaper editor, has the knack of predicting headline stories and claims to be the Devil.

4.title: No Time Like the Past

4.title: The Parallel
4.description: An astronaut blacks out while orbiting the earth and ends up in a parallel universe.

4.title: I Dream of Genie
4.description: A man considers several possibilities when offered one wish by a genie.

4.title: The New Exhibit
4.description: The curator of a murderers' row in a soon-to-be-defunct wax museum persuades the owner to let him keep the figures for awhile. When his wife attempts to destroy them, a new murderous rampage begins...

4.title: Of Late I Think of Cliffordville
4.description: A bored, wealthy businessman gets a chance to go back in time and start over, armed with all the knowledge he's acquired...an arsenal that's not as powerful as he thinks.

4.title: The Incredible World of Horace Ford
4.description: Toy designer Horace Ford spends most of his time reminiscing about his idyllic childhood. But when he gets a chance to go back to those years he gets a bitter taste of reality.

4.title: On Thursday We Leave for Home
4.description: The leader of an expedition on an asteroid tries to convince the others that Earth is not worth returning to.

4.title: Passage on the Lady Anne
4.description: A quarrelsome young couple find themselves taking a trip on the Lady Anne, an old passenger liner that is transporting a group of equally old passengers.

4.title: The Bard
4.description: An untalented would-be writer's career takes off when the ghost of William Shakespeare writes his script.

5.title: In Praise of Pip

5.title: Steel
5.description: A small-time promoter desperately in need of money takes the place of his broken-down robot in a prize fight where humans are barred from participating.

5.title: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet

1.title: The Long Bright Dark
1.description: Former Louisiana State CID partners Martin Hart and Rustin Cohle give separate statements to a pair of investigators about the murder of a prostitute, Dora Lange, 17 years earlier. As they look back, details of the crime, replete with occult overtones, are accompanied by insights into the detectives’ volatile partnership and personal lives.

1.title: Seeing Things
1.description: Under pressure to land a suspect in the Lange murder, Quesada warns Hart and Cohle that they might be replaced by three detectives from a new task force. The pair lobbies for extra time to follow up on a lead that takes them from a rural cathouse to an incinerated church. With his marriage to Maggie already strained by work, Hart finds respite away from home.

1.title: The Locked Room
1.description: A hidden image at the burned-out church leads Cohle and Hart to Joel Theriot, a tent-revival minister whose parishioners finger a scarred “tall man” seen with Dora Lange. Brought in for interrogation, a sex offender matching the description is quickly dismissed by Cohle, despite offering a confession. Hart gets sidetracked after Maggie sets Cohle up with a friend at a C&W bar. Looking to establish a pattern of murder, Cohle pores over old case files, finding a connection with a woman assumed to have drowned years earlier.

1.title: Who Goes There?
1.description: Hart and Cohle hunt for their newly identified suspect, Reggie Ledoux, a meth cooker who shared a cell with Dora Lange's husband and recently skipped parole. As Hart's personal life collapses around him, Cohle immerses himself in an old criminal identity from his narco days, contacting an East-Texas biker gang known to deal with their primary suspect.

1.title: The Secret Fate of All Life
1.description: A violent denouement in the forest clears the Dora Lange case and turns Cohle and Hart into local heroes. Each man settles into a healthier rhythm of living as Hart returns to his family, and Cohle starts a relationship while gaining a reputation as a closer in interrogations. As time passes and his daughters grow older, Hart faces new tensions and temptations, and Cohle learns from a double-murder suspect that there could be much more to an old case than he'd once thought. In 2012, Gilbough and Papania put their cards on the table, presenting new intelligence that threatens Cohle and causes Hart to reassess everything he thought he knew about his former partner.

1.description: Maggie reveals Cohle's activities in 2002, when his relationship with Hart fractured and he quit the force.

1.title: After You've Gone
1.description: Hart and Cohle call a truce to investigate a series of disappearances that may be related to the Dora Lange murder and the Tuttle family.

1.title: Form and Void
1.description: An overlooked detail provides Hart and Cohle with an important new lead in their 17-year-old case.

1.title: The View at 14
1.description: Koyuki Tanaka is in a dead end. At age 14, he has lost his passion for life. But a casual meeting of Koyuki with a young musician named Ryusuke is about to open a new path in front of him.

1.title: Live House
1.description: When Koyuki accepts Ryusuke's invitation to see his band perform live, he unwittingly sets down a path of self-discovery. But what Koyuki finds both disturbs and intrigues him, as the youngster uncovers the best and worst aspects of human nature.

1.title: Moon on the Water
1.description: Koyuki hangs out with Ryusuke and finds out more about music, and meets his sister, Maho, who later takes Koyuki to see Beck, her brother's dog.

1.title: Strum the Guitar
1.description: While Koyuki takes his first tentative steps toward learning guitar, Maho suggests that he'd be the perfect lead vocalist for Ryusuke's new band. But an accident threatens to shatter Ryusuke and Koyuki's friendship forever, as well as putting an end to Koyuki's musical aspirations-until help comes from a very unexpected source.

1.title: Beck
1.description: Koyuki's guitar training is coming along slowly but surely, until Saitou decides to speed things up by entering him to play in the annual summer festival! Meanwhile, Ryusuke and Chiba put their heads together to come up with a name for their new band.

1.title: Hyodo and the Jaguar
1.description: Taira, the newest member of Beck and the others have their first session together to start the band off on a good note. Koyuki's teacher is on maternity leave and a new cute teacher is introduced. As coordinator of the choir contest, she wants Koyuki to be the leader for the class to get them ready for the contest.

1.title: Prudence
1.description: Koyuki tries to memorize the scales at Saitou's place. Later we can see Koyuki talking with the bullies and then scolded in the teacher's office. Maho meets with him, and at Saitou's place, Koyuki tells her why he started to work for the old man.

1.title: Broadcast in the School
1.description: Koyuki visits an instrument shop and practices some more. The school year ends. Next Momoko meets Koyuki accidentally going in Saitou's place and decides to go with him to check whether he works there. Koyuki tries to sell off Saitou's pornographic magazines.

1.title: Night Before LIVE
1.description: Koyuki and Saku become friends. Koyuki gets nominated for the most difficult swimming races in the school's competition. Koyuki takes Saku to see Beck's show.

1.title: FACE
1.description: Koyuki and Saku become friends. Koyuki gets nominated for the most difficult swimming races in the school's competition. Koyuki takes Saku to see Beck's show.

1.title: Summer Holidays
1.description: The band tries to raise some money and Chiba finds out that Dying Breed is coming to Japan. Later on Koyuki talks to a teacher about his decreasing grades. Momoko asks the band to enter the school festival.

1.title: Secret Live
1.description: Dying Breed performs in concert live in Japan, with Koyuki unexpectedly guest singing. Later on, Koyuki and Izumi meet again and she invites him for night-swimming, much to Maho's chagrin when she finds out.

1.title: Ciel Bleu
1.description: Ryusuke's been bothered by Erica Blige's death and often checks the news. At school, Saku and Koyuki form a band for the cultural festival with Tanabe and a bassist. Tanabe names the band Ciel Bleu. Hyodo tries to ruin Ciel Bleu's practice.

1.title: Dream
1.description: Mitty brings the cover design for the Beck band logo. Izumi meets up with Maho to clear the misunderstanding between them.

1.title: Back to School
1.description: Koyuki tries to learn for his exams, but it doesn't go well. At school there's a rumor about Momoko working in a lingerie pub.

1.title: Indies
1.description: Gordie comes to see Eddie about the stolen stuff including Prudence. Then Eddie and Ryusuke talk about it on the phone. Koyuki still works hard to earn cash for the Telecaster and we can see a girl who works next door for the second time. At school, Tanaka finds out that one of Maho's friends is quite famous. Beck performs and is heard by Chicagoan records agent, named Frank Albin, allowing for a possible big break.

1.title: Three Days
1.description: Ryusuke wants to release Beck's album in America. Koyuki finally buys the Telecaster. Koyuki sees at school the same girl, named Hiromi, who he saw in the doughnut store next to his workplace.

1.title: Leon Sykes
1.description: Koyuki talks with his boss about his band. Saku then joins Koyuki at Saito's swimming practice. Beck is allowed to perform at the Marquee's evening show as Hitode's support, because the manager really liked Koyuki's singing.

1.title: Blues
1.description: Ryusuke (along with Beck and Prudence) get kidnapped by Sykes, who takes him to meet his uncle, the bluesman John Lee Davis, who wanted to know who had stolen Prudence.

1.title: Grateful Sound
1.description: At the fishing pond the band talks with Kazuo about Greatful Sound. She wants Ryusuke to ask Eddie to come. Ryusuke agrees, but he also wants Beck to play although Ran is strongly against it.

1.title: Write Music
1.description: Ryusuke talks with Chiba and Taira about his talk with Sykes. Back at school, Hiromi talks with Koyuki and Saku about playing guitar.

1.title: The Night Before The Festival
1.description: The band tries to improve the new song and Koyuki tries to write the lyrics, at Ryusuke's request. Saito tries to help Koyuki come up with some lyrics.

1.title: Festival
1.description: The Greatful Sound festival is on, with Belle Ame on the primary stage, Malcolm (a Sykes-managed rapper) on the second stage, and Beck on the smallest third stage.

1.title: Third Stage
1.description: After the band seems to break up before their time on the third stage, the band is slowly reforming just in time to play their hearts out for the growing crowd.

1.title: Slip Out
1.description: As Beck's set finishes up, the reality that it's Beck's last performance finally sets in.

1.title: America
1.description: Koyuki plans to revive Beck and sets out to get the band together.

1.title: Welcome to Widow's Bay!

1.title: What to Expect on Your Trip

1.title: Our History

1.title: Seasickness

1.title: Your Baggage
1.description: Don't worry about misplaced luggage. Old baggage always resurfaces in Widow's Bay.

1.title: Emergency Shelter

1.title: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!
1.description: We understand that hard choices had to be made and we may never be the same, but we hope you'll visit again!
